clean_body: I’m ready to fight back against the SAVE Act, but I can’t do it without you! | | | Hey there, Peter, One thing we teach kids in the classroom is that every American has the right to vote, and it’s part of our civic duty to participate in our democracy. But right now, our right to vote is under attack by extremists in Washington, D.C. This week, National Republicans are pushing the “SAVE Act” — a deceptive piece of legislation that is nothing more than a blatant attempt at voter suppression. = | = Republicans claim this is about "election integrity," but let’s look at the facts: This bill goes far beyond simple photo ID requirements. It would mandate that voters provide a birth certificate or a passport just to register to vote. The reality is that millions of eligible voters do not have these documents readily available. Women who took their husband’s last name will face significant bureaucratic hurdles to prove their identity and citizenship. Obtaining these documents costs money. By requiring expensive paperwork to exercise the right to vote, this bill will create a modern-day poll tax. They also want to eliminate mail-in voting — a system that has proven to be safe, secure, and essential for accessibility in states like Utah. In my classroom, I’ve taught my students that their voices matter. In Congress, I will fight to make sure they actually do. We cannot allow extremist politicians to pick their own voters by making it even harder to cast a ballot. Peter, The SAVE America Act is being debated in the Senate, and the fight to protect the integrity of your vote is on.

Here is what this bill does:

It requires proof of U.S. citizenship to register to vote in federal elections. And it requires photo ID at the polls. Simple, common sense, long overdue.

**If you need an ID to board a plane, open a bank account, or buy cold medicine, you should need one to vote.** This is not controversial. It is common sense.

The political establishment and their media allies are going to throw everything they have at this bill. They will call it extreme. They will say it suppresses votes. They will do what they always do when someone in Washington tries to do the right thing.

_I am not backing down._

A Special Message from our SponsorPlease note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Parler and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Parler.
Sound of FreedomThis Lent, your faith can help protect the innocent. ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE

Friend,

Lent is not just a season.

It is a pilgrimage.

A journey led by the Holy Spirit… into the desert.

And the desert is not empty.
It is sacred.
It is where God reminds us who we are.

When Jesus entered the desert, He was tempted. He was tested.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

But even then, one holy declaration still echoed from Heaven and did not change: “You are my beloved Son.”

That same Father speaks over you.

You are His beloved son.
His beloved daughter.

Before any label.
Before any denomination.

And so is every child.

Even the child who has been lured… kidnapped… sold.

You may not know me yet.

My name is Eduardo Verástegui.

I produced the film Sound of Freedom after meeting real-life rescuers who risk everything to save children from trafficking.

What I heard broke my heart.

Children treated like products.
Like profit.
Like they do not matter.

I asked myself,

“What if it were my child?”

That question changed my life. The film became a movement.
And the Sound of Freedom Foundation was born.

But the story did not end when the credits rolled.

Today, our foundation works to prevent trafficking before it begins.

We equip trusted partners who rescue children.
We educate families so they can protect their sons and daughters.
We advocate for laws that defend the innocent.

This is not politics.
It is protection.
It is faith in action.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

But if we are honest…

Our hearts can grow numb and we get distracted. We get comfortable.

Lent is a wake-up call.

A time for metanoia.
A turning back to God.

This Lenten season, pause and ask the Holy Spirit:

“What do You want to restore in me?”

Your prayer life?
Your courage?
Your tenderness toward the vulnerable?

Because when hearts grow cold…children suffer.

And today, many of God’s children are enslaved.

They are created in His image.
They belong to Him.
Their dignity is sacred.

When we forget that… the innocent pay the price.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

During Lent, I pray more intentionally.

I ask the Holy Spirit to strengthen us for this battle.

As a Catholic, I also ask for the prayers of the faithful who have gone before us.

I ask Our Lady of Guadalupe to intercede for these little ones.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

I ask Saint Joseph to guard them.
I ask Saint Michael to defend them.

Not instead of God.

But asking them to pray with us… as one family in Christ.
Because this is spiritual warfare.

Light against darkness.

And Jesus was clear:

“Whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.” (Matthew 25:40)

When we protect a child, we serve Christ.
When we rescue the vulnerable, we love Christ.

Friend, you may be hearing about this mission for the first time.

But maybe this is not an accident.

Maybe the Holy Spirit is inviting you into something deeper this Lent.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Protect God’s Children Now

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Let Him restore your heart.

And together, let us restore freedom to enslaved children of God.

This is not about one church.
It is about the Gospel.

It is about the truth that every human life has dignity because it comes from God.

So we say it boldly:

God’s children are not for sale.

Not in our nation. Not in our world.
Not ever.

Will you stand with us?

With gratitude and prayer,

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation

subject: Re: competing against Sununu.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
The GOP sees this race as one of their best opportunities to flip a Senate seat.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260323_1.BtDU2B&refcode=em20260323-1&t=1&akid=5724%2E582294%2EOuUXak)
I know what it’s like to run against a Republican with high name ID and a national donor network behind him — I’ve done it before. And I won.
Now, Chris Pappas is facing the same kind of threat in New Hampshire. National Republicans managed to recruit former Senator John Sununu into the race — and the latest polling shows this race will be close.
Look, in order for Democrats to take back the Senate majority and put an end to Trump’s unchecked power, winning in New Hampshire is absolutely critical.
**[That’s why I’m in this fight with everything I’ve got. And why I’m asking you to please pitch in $5 right now to help Chris Pappas stand up to big-money Republicans, compete against John Sununu, and keep this seat blue.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260323_1.BtDU2B&refcode=em20260323-1&t=2&akid=5724%2E582294%2EOuUXak)**
**[Donate $5 to support Chris Pappas »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260323_1.ruxYuj&refcode=em20260323-1&t=3&akid=5724%2E582294%2EOuUXak)**
Chris is a Granite Stater through and through. He’s not in this for power or prestige or to cozy up to billionaires. _He’s in it to make life better for working families — the folks who get up every day, work hard, and are struggling to get by._ He’s fought Big Pharma to lower prescription drug prices, stood up for veterans, and protected reproductive rights when they’ve been under relentless attack.
Chris Pappas fights for the people — not the wealthy and well-connected. He shows up, he listens, and he gets things done. That’s what New Hampshire needs, and it’s what working people across the country need.
**But Republicans know New Hampshire is one of their best shots at flipping a Senate seat this year.** Sununu has the name recognition, the right-wing billionaire network, and the full weight of the national GOP behind him.
We’ve seen this before. Special interests will flood races with corporate money and try to buy Senators who will work for them instead of their constituents. We can’t let this happen in New Hampshire.
**If you believe, like I do, that government ought to work for working people — not the rich and powerful —[then I’m asking you to please chip in to Chris’s campaign now to help him compete and win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260323_1.BtDU2B&refcode=em20260323-1&t=4&akid=5724%2E582294%2EOuUXak)**
I know Chris has what it takes to win this race. But we all need to make sure he has the resources to fight back against this massive right-wing spending.
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

**ICYMI: TRUMP CALLS LETLOW “TOTAL WINNER” IN LOUISIANA SENATE RACE**
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – In a new [Truth Social post](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=75f167257a&e=95355a072c), President Trump calls Letlow a “Total Winner” who has “always delivered for Louisiana” and lays out the agenda he knows she will fight for in the Senate, including border security, energy dominance, tax cuts, support for Louisiana farmers and fishermen, and the full America First agenda.
Despite advertisements by other candidates designed to blur President Trump’s position in this race, the President himself has made it clear: Julia Letlow is the ONLY Trump-endorsed candidate in Louisiana’s Senate race.
_“I am honored by President Trump’s confidence, and I intend to earn it every single day,”_ **said Rep. Letlow.**_“He called on me to run because he knows Louisiana deserves a senator who will put America first, fight for our state, and never waver. That is exactly what I will do.”_
The contrast in this race has not changed. Julia Letlow is the Trump-endorsed conservative who will stand with President Trump in the United States Senate. Bill Cassidy voted to convict him and has never answered to Louisiana Republicans for it.
**President Trump’s full statement below:**
_“Highly Respected America First Congresswoman, Julia Letlow, of the wonderful State of Louisiana, is a Great Star, has been from the very beginning, and only gets better! Julia is running for the United States Senate in Louisiana, a place I love and WON BIG, six times, including Primaries, in 2016, 2020, and 2024! I know Julia well, have seen her tested at the highest and most difficult levels, and she is a TOTAL WINNER! A Proud Mother of two children, Julia is a wonderful person, has ALWAYS delivered for Louisiana, and would continue doing so in the United States Senate. As your next Senator, Julia will work tirelessly to Grow our Economy, Cut Taxes and Regulations, Support our Amazing Farmers and Fishermen, Champion Louisiana Oil & Gas, Unleash American Energy DOMINANCE, Promote MADE IN THE U.S.A., Keep our Border SECURE, Stop Migrant Crime, Ensure LAW AND ORDER, Strengthen our Military/Veterans, and Protect our always under siege Second Amendment. Julia Letlow has my Complete and Total Endorsement — SHE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN!”_

name: Scott Peters
subject: Still fighting for affordable healthcare
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Peters for Congress
body:
---
| | Peter,

It’s been sixteen years since the Affordable Care Act was signed into law, and since then, millions of Americans have been able to get coverage they couldn’t access before.

And yet after all this time, Republicans have NOT put forward a comprehensive plan for reform, despite launching constant attacks on affordable healthcare.

In December, I voted against their bill, which failed to renew premium tax credits and has now led to skyrocketing healthcare premiums. It wasn’t the first time, nor will it be the last, that I have voted against Republican efforts to repeal the ACA or cut Medicaid funding.

The Affordable Care Act isn’t perfect, but it remains an important foundation. We should be focused on building on what works: lowering costs, improving quality of care, and making coverage more stable and accessible.

subject: Trump’s latest attempt at voter suppression.

body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter,
Trump's latest attack on voting rights is sitting in the Senate—and now, he’s doubling down with an even tougher version of the original bill.
Make no mistake, this is about voter suppression.
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
It would require voters to prove themselves with EITHER:
* A passport
* Valid photo ID with the name that matches their birth certificate
Only 50% of Americans have a passport, and one in four voters could be disenfranchised by the ID requirement.
If a voter has changed their name for any reason, whether that’s getting married, being legally adopted, or reflecting their gender identity, this bill could stop them from voting.
Never mind that the U.S. ALREADY has citizenship requirements for anyone who registers to vote. Donald Trump’s plan would only add more barriers, discouraging women, lower-income people, people of color, and naturalized citizens from exercising their democratic right.
Here’s what we’re doing:
* I submitted an amendment to stop it, but of course, the GOP blocked it because they know they cannot win in the 2026 midterms without cheating. Leader Schumer says not a single Senate Democrat will support these bills.
* Democratic attorneys general are already preparing to fight if the administration tries to confiscate ballots, voting machines, or disrupt the postal service’s handling of mail-in ballots. They are also preparing to fight against government intimidation—if Trump sends his ICE army to scare voters.
Donald Trump knows his policies aren’t popular. He knows the American people will reject him and his MAGA cohort at the ballot box. So instead of focusing on healthcare, the cost of groceries, and getting us out of another cruel, useless war, he is attacking our democracy and undermining our right to vote.
Oregon has the best electoral system in the country. Our vote-by-mail approach is secure, equitable, and democratic. We won’t let Donald Trump take that away.
We need to be vigilant as we head into the upcoming midterm elections so that he does not hijack the process to keep himself in power. Our government should have power only with the consent of the governed.
— Maxine

Now she's using those skills in Congress to ensure healthy communities by standing up to Big Pharma, fighting climate change, and expanding reproductive rights, as well as rebuilding a fair economy for all by protecting Social Security and Medicare.

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Listening to Donald Trump or reading his social media posts, it seems like the guy has gone off the deep end.
And look — maybe he has. At a minimum he has proven himself to be increasingly unhinged and incoherent.
But the reality is, a lot of what Trump is doing is a purposeful strategy.
Steve Bannon let us all in on their “flood the zone” strategy back in 2018: do so much that’s so bad, and do it so often , that people just don’t have the time or energy to fight back.
Flooding the zone with one egregious transgression after another starts making the chaos feel normal — and it can even make it hard to drum up the righteous outrage we should be feeling.
But knowing that this is their actual strategy makes it that much more important for us to pay attention and speak out.
So here’s my recipe for fighting back:
1. Tune in. I’m not saying you have to watch the news 24/7 or keep push alerts on your phone. But we don’t have the luxury of burying our heads in the sand and just hoping this will take care of itself.
2. Connect with people around you. I know from my work in post-coup transitions and post-conflict resolution that community is one of the most critical parts of recovering from democratic backslides. We can’t isolate ourselves — join a group, talk with your neighbors, spend time with friends and family.
3. When you can, support Democratic candidates who are trying to reestablish stability in Washington. There are so many great Democrats who will be on the ballot this year — frontline Members of Congress defending their seats, challengers trying to kick out Republicans, and state and local leaders on the ground. All of them could use our support to win.
As for the first two: I’ll continue keeping you updated on important news through these emails, and sharing ways to connect when I can. (One great option is to find your local Indivisible group [https://indivisible.org/get-involved/find-a-group/] !)
And when it comes to securing Democratic victories in November, my team is working hard on all our plans to support key Democratic races. We’ll be channeling support directly to the candidates who need it most.
If you want to be a part of that work, please chip in today. I can promise you your donation will be put to good use to support Democratic wins here in California and across the country. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=50]

> > The term, "eminent domain," when invoked by government, infers a sense of nobility, honorability, and indicates an exercise for the public's common good. In many cases, the use of eminent domain can be beneficial to a community in need but should only be utilized when no other alternatives exist. Sadly, more often than not, it's used as a bludgeoning tool to lawfully take property from legal landowners, under the guise of the "greater public good," or in the "public's best interest."
>
> The core concept behind eminent domain is that government can claim private property for public use but must pay "just compensation." And to be clear, the term "just compensation" is not some simple phrase created out of thin air; it is deeply rooted in the Fifth Amendment of the Constitution and buttressed by numerous Supreme Court rulings over the years. The Fifth Amendment's Taking's Clause prohibits the government from taking property for public use without providing "just compensation."
>> [Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.h92AjpWKwW7Cp5hj2kzvLGvR_5yQDzR1rf8Un7UUmwI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=191877232)
>> Enter Christian Faith Center Church and its sprawling 50-acre campus in Federal Way Washington. The Christian church, child day-care center and Pacific Christian Academy property has been targeted for condemnation or acquisition by Western Washington's public transit agency, Sound Transit. Sound Transit intends to use the property for "potential future light rail expansion" and a facility for testing and conditioning of its light rail vehicles. Despite numerous alternative sites that exist, the thriving Christian community campus was chosen above all others for the taking.
>
> Current estimates show Sound Transit running between a 20-30-billion-dollar structural deficit, which is expected to increase substantially with cost overruns up and ridership down significantly. The parallels between Gavin Newsome's train to nowhere in California, AKA the "Bakersfield Express" are astounding, especially when you consider the lack of federal tax dollars and grants, which are drying up considerably. These boondoggles are no longer being funded by the federal government due to the lack of transparency and the complete disregard for financial accountability. It's simply outrageous how this legal tool is being wielded not for altruistic reasons, but rather as an instrument of political self-interest.
>
> The "takings clause" applies not only to the actual land, but includes existing structures as well as intangible assets, such as planned future site development and premeditated revenue streams. When considering the "just compensation" aspect, all of this must be measured when applying a dollar figure so that "no one citizen bears the burden of public benefit costs alone," as stated in the "Takings Clause." Most courts have been consistent with this component of the eminent domain process, but the rules are different in progressive led states; their prejudiced posture towards Christian and Jewish facilities have become nothing short of overtly disparate.
>
> Appraisers are hired by the government simply to assess property values often with minimal regard to the intangibles that are supposed to be recognized in the "just compensation" clause. They ignore years of communal connections, and community investments of time, talent, and treasure. But to make matters even worse for the prospering Christian Church, if that were even possible, King County Washington has placed a moratorium on the building of new church facilities within its governing jurisdiction; thus, creating a first amendment conflict as well. Not only do they intend on taking the land and structures for pennies on the dollar but will not allow the religious organization to rebuild within its governing region. How's that for an "eminent domain?"
>
> Why should we the people accept this? The First Amendment is the foundation for America's Constitution, ensuring American citizens religious liberty "in the free exercise thereof." Those five words have been the basis for countless landmark Supreme Court decisions over the years. King County Washington and Sound Transit have seemingly conspired to violate the Christian Church's ability to, not only receive "just compensation," but to rebuild and tend to its flock within the community by putting a church construction moratorium in place. If we allow this injustice to continue unchallenged, we become complicit in the systematic oppression of the very fabric of America's Constitution and the freedom to practice one's religion.
>
> Religious institutions such as Christian Faith Center should not have to watch helplessly as their dreams of sharing the gospel turn to dust, only to be replaced with a dysfunctional and bankrupted public organization like Sound Transit. This so-called "greater good" justification rarely filters back to those who lose everything in the process. An entire church community must now scatter and attempt to stitch their spiritual lives together and start anew elsewhere. The number of prospective victims is endless. How can you possibly place a price tag on that, while excluding them from rebuilding within the community?
>
> This case is very unique, and we cannot remain silent while eminent domain is wielded like a weapon against the religious community. This is not a simple battle of landowners versus government, it's a fight for religious freedom, which is enshrined in America's Constitution. In this case, if the government is going to willfully disregard the "just compensation" clause and then place a moratorium on the construction of new churches; they will have effectively violated both the first and fifth amendment of our constitution of tens of thousands of potential church going litigants.

clean_body: If "eminent domain" can bulldoze a thriving community over a "potential future" plan, do property rights mean anything anymore? | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? If "eminent domain" can bulldoze a thriving community over a "potential future" plan, do property rights mean anything anymore? | | | Mar 23 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- > The term, "eminent domain," when invoked by government, infers a sense of nobility, honorability, and indicates an exercise for the public's common good. In many cases, the use of eminent domain can be beneficial to a community in need but should only be utilized when no other alternatives exist. Sadly, more often than not, it's used as a bludgeoning tool to lawfully take property from legal landowners, under the guise of the "greater public good," or in the "public's best interest." The core concept behind eminent domain is that government can claim private property for public use but must pay "just compensation." And to be clear, the term "just compensation" is not some simple phrase created out of thin air; it is deeply rooted in the Fifth Amendment of the Constitution and buttressed by numerous Supreme Court rulings over the years. The Fifth Amendment's Taking's Clause prohibits the government from taking property for public use without providing "just compensation." > > Enter Christian Faith Center Church and its sprawling 50-acre campus in Federal Way Washington. The Christian church, child day-care center and Pacific Christian Academy property has been targeted for condemnation or acquisition by Western Washington's public transit agency, Sound Transit. Sound Transit intends to use the property for "potential future light rail expansion" and a facility for testing and conditioning of its light rail vehicles. Despite numerous alternative sites that exist, the thriving Christian community campus was chosen above all others for the taking. Current estimates show Sound Transit running between a 20-30-billion-dollar structural deficit, which is expected to increase substantially with cost overruns up and ridership down significantly. The parallels between Gavin Newsome's train to nowhere in California, AKA the "Bakersfield Express" are astounding, especially when you consider the lack of federal tax dollars and grants, which are drying up considerably. These boondoggles are no longer being funded by the federal government due to the lack of transparency and the complete disregard for financial accountability. It's simply outrageous how this legal tool is being wielded not for altruistic reasons, but rather as an instrument of political self-interest. The "takings clause" applies not only to the actual land, but includes existing structures as well as intangible assets, such as planned future site development and premeditated revenue streams. When considering the "just compensation" aspect, all of this must be measured when applying a dollar figure so that "no one citizen bears the burden of public benefit costs alone," as stated in the "Takings Clause." Most courts have been consistent with this component of the eminent domain process, but the rules are different in progressive led states; their prejudiced posture towards Christian and Jewish facilities have become nothing short of overtly disparate. Appraisers are hired by the government simply to assess property values often with minimal regard to the intangibles that are supposed to be recognized in the "just compensation" clause. They ignore years of communal connections, and community investments of time, talent, and treasure. But to make matters even worse for the prospering Christian Church, if that were even possible, King County Washington has placed a moratorium on the building of new church facilities within its governing jurisdiction; thus, creating a first amendment conflict as well. Not only do they intend on taking the land and structures for pennies on the dollar but will not allow the religious organization to rebuild within its governing region. How's that for an "eminent domain?" Why should we the people accept this? The First Amendment is the foundation for America's Constitution, ensuring American citizens religious liberty "in the free exercise thereof." Those five words have been the basis for countless landmark Supreme Court decisions over the years. King County Washington and Sound Transit have seemingly conspired to violate the Christian Church's ability to, not only receive "just compensation," but to rebuild and tend to its flock within the community by putting a church construction moratorium in place. If we allow this injustice to continue unchallenged, we become complicit in the systematic oppression of the very fabric of America's Constitution and the freedom to practice one's religion. Religious institutions such as Christian Faith Center should not have to watch helplessly as their dreams of sharing the gospel turn to dust, only to be replaced with a dysfunctional and bankrupted public organization like Sound Transit. This so-called "greater good" justification rarely filters back to those who lose everything in the process. An entire church community must now scatter and attempt to stitch their spiritual lives together and start anew elsewhere. The number of prospective victims is endless. How can you possibly place a price tag on that, while excluding them from rebuilding within the community? This case is very unique, and we cannot remain silent while eminent domain is wielded like a weapon against the religious community. This is not a simple battle of landowners versus government, it's a fight for religious freedom, which is enshrined in America's Constitution. In this case, if the government is going to willfully disregard the "just compensation" clause and then place a moratorium on the construction of new churches; they will have effectively violated both the first and fifth amendment of our constitution of tens of thousands of potential church going litigants. Let's not confuse any of Trump's bizarre actions this weekend with strength. He is a profoundly weak man--bleeding support across America, with new polling showing his disapproval rating in the 60s. So when you see him deploying ICE agents to take over American airports instead of working with Congress to fund the Department of Homeland Security and make sure TSA agents get paid, understand what that actually is: weakness. He's politically weak, and he's losing this fight.
* * *

_The BBC caught scam call center workers on hidden cameras as they laughed at the people they were tricking. One worker even bragged about making $250k from victims._
_The disturbing truth is --this isn't random. Scammers don't just pick numbers out of nowhere. They're buying your data from brokers. Once your data is out there, it's not just calls--it's phishing, impersonation, and identity theft._

* * *
The vast majority of Americans understand that he's in control of Washington. He controls Republicans in Congress. If they wanted to pay TSA agents, they could do it right now. So this attempt to force Democrats to the table by threatening to bring ICE in? It's backfired spectacularly. All it's done is highlight the real issue: Republicans will only fund DHS if they can shovel an insane amount of additional resources to ICE--after multiple Americans have died, after people are being grabbed off the streets, after deaths inside detention facilities.
The American people are not going to stand for that. And Trump's reaction to it is, again, a sign of weakness.
And it goes further. You may have seen Trump's disgusting response to Robert Mueller's death over the weekend. Mueller served his country his entire life. He deserves basic respect for that--not to be mocked by a sitting president who seems to celebrate the death of his enemies. And in the same breath, Trump is out there calling Democrats the biggest threat to the country because he "took out Iran."
The way he talks about his enemies is its own kind of tell. A man with real strength--real power--doesn't act like that. Someone who actually knows how to lead, how to build, how to get things done, doesn't need to behave like a petty asshole in public. Even if they hated someone privately, they'd understand that leadership requires at least a baseline of dignity. People expect that. They want a president who can attempt--at minimum--to bring the country together.
And we got a glimpse of that contrast this weekend. Barack Obama released a thoughtful, respectful statement honoring Mueller's life and career. It was a reminder: we don't have to accept this. We don't have to live with weak, selfish, morally bankrupt people running the country--people who act on impulse, enrich themselves, protect their creepy friends and wealthy donors, and do absolutely nothing for the American public.
We can have better. We've had better.
We can get back to a president with basic decency--someone who tries to bring people together in moments that actually matter: after a school shooting, a terror attack, a political assassination. I'll never forget Trump's response to Melissa Hortman's murder in Minneapolis, followed by him lecturing Democrats about rhetoric after Charlie Kirk's assassination. Two moments where any halfway competent leader could've lowered the temperature--if not out of principle, then at least for the optics. But he couldn't do it. Because at his core, he's a man of low moral character.
Now fast forward to this morning's news on Iran. Trump is suddenly scheduling a five-day pause on airstrikes--conveniently stepping back from the war crimes he was openly flirting with just days ago around the Strait of Hormuz. This entire situation has already created massive global economic instability--not to mention loss of life in the Middle East, risks to American troops, and the growing threat of retaliatory attacks hanging over everyday Americans just trying to live their lives.
We're in a bad spot. And right-wing media wants to spin this as Trump being "magnanimous," creating space for negotiations.
Maybe he finds an off-ramp. Maybe he declares victory in a week, or a month, or whenever it's politically convenient. But let's be honest about what this actually is.
I don't believe a word he says about this war. He lies constantly. He changes positions constantly. This looks a hell of a lot more like market panic than strategy. He saw where things were heading--the Dow, the S&P, Wall Street getting ready to turn on him--and he flinched. Because the economic consequences of spiking oil, gas, diesel, and fertilizer prices are no joke. There are serious economists warning this could trigger a shock on the scale of 2008--maybe worse.
And even if they reopened the Strait tomorrow, the damage doesn't just magically disappear.
This is, again, weakness. He's flailing for an exit instead of leading with an actual plan--because there is no plan. They got dragged into this. Israel keeps bombing. Iran says they won't negotiate. I don't trust Iran for a second, but that's the reality on the table.
There's no meaningful progress here. This looks like an administration scrambling to stabilize markets and keep billionaire donors calm--because they've already been caught playing games, manipulating markets, and cashing in behind the scenes.
And at every level, it comes back to the same thing: weakness.
A president too weak to tell his own party to pass a clean funding bill for TSA. A president who thinks bullying and theatrics are substitutes for leadership. A president who lashes out at the dead because he can't control the living. A president who launches a war with no plan and puts wildly unqualified people in charge of executing it.
We all know Pete Hegseth and Marco Rubio are out of their depth. That's been obvious from day one.
This is what weakness looks like. And the weaker he gets, the more cornered he gets, the more unhinged he'll become--the crazier the rhetoric, the weirder the behavior, the louder the attempts to project strength.
But it's all projection.
He's weak.
And we're beating him.
Most Americans are sick of this shit. They're tired of the chaos, the constant noise, the feeling that every day is another manufactured crisis designed to benefit the same small group of wealthy insiders.
That's why Democrats are going to win the midterms. I believe that. And the numbers back it up.
Honestly, we may be heading toward something worse for Republicans than 2018. The economy is shaky. The chaos is constant. But Democrats still have to do the work--and yeah, we have a long track record of fucking that up. That part doesn't fix itself.
But the opportunity is there.
And I, for one, am sick and goddamn tired of waking up every morning to a White House that operates like a mass chaos machine--serving nobody except the wealthy and the elite.

Peter,
The Supreme Court just heard arguments this morning in Watson v. RNC, a case that could invalidate laws in 30 states which allow for counting ballots that are postmarked by Election Day but received later.
And the Court's six conservative justices seem ready to rubber stamp one of Donald Trump's signature anti-voting priorities just months ahead of the midterm elections:

Peter, we won't sugarcoat this: this is a troubling sign for our democracy and for fairness in our elections.
This isn't really about mail-in ballot deadlines, issues with the Postal Service, or some technical dispute between state law and federal law.
This is about chipping away at the right to vote, dismantling our constitutional rights bit by bit until voting is once again reserved only for the privileged few.
Republicans will not settle for this one victory against mail-in ballot deadlines. They have their sights set on bigger targets: banning early voting, outlawing absentee voting, and implementing a strict federal voter ID law that would disenfranchise millions overnight.
As the Supreme Court and the Trump Administration make voting harder, we have to fight even harder to win the redistricting war to overcome the hurdles MAGA is putting up to stop people from voting them out of power.
Our ballot measure to redraw Colorado's congressional map would flip three GOP-held red seats in blue state Colorado. The stakes here are as high as they get. If MAGA can whittle away at voting rights piece by piece AND gerrymander the House to prevent Dems from taking control, we could potentially never retake power in Congress.

clean_body: As the Supreme Court and the Trump Administration make voting more difficult, we have to work even harder to win the redistricting war to overcome MAGA’s hurdles. | | | | | == Peter, The Supreme Court just heard arguments this morning in Watson v. RNC, a case that could invalidate laws in 30 states which allow for counting ballots that are postmarked by Election Day but received later. And the Court's six conservative justices seem ready to rubber stamp one of Donald Trump's signature anti-voting priorities just months ahead of the midterm elections: | == Peter, we won't sugarcoat this: this is a troubling sign for our democracy and for fairness in our elections. This isn't really about mail-in ballot deadlines, issues with the Postal Service, or some technical dispute between state law and federal law. This is about chipping away at the right to vote, dismantling our constitutional rights bit by bit until voting is once again reserved only for the privileged few. Republicans will not settle for this one victory against mail-in ballot deadlines. They have their sights set on bigger targets: banning early voting, outlawing absentee voting, and implementing a strict federal voter ID law that would disenfranchise millions overnight. As the Supreme Court and the Trump Administration make voting harder, we have to fight even harder to win the redistricting war to overcome the hurdles MAGA is putting up to stop people from voting them out of power. Our ballot measure to redraw Colorado's congressional map would flip three GOP-held red seats in blue state Colorado. The stakes here are as high as they get. name: Autism Health
subject: The Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
body:
** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JyPTtXfKYd8&mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is just 4 weeks away, and we are excited to welcome our community for three powerful days of education, connection, and collaboration. As our flagship educational event, the Summit brings together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to host an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore emerging research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can apply in real life. To view the full list of speakers and sessions, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/ahsconference.com%2Fagenda%2F/b43o/MzbEAQ/AQ/c1cc1bc8-a8ff-44a9-988c-97509dbd06c9/2/rhAkaeYVNS?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

See our PRESS RELEASE HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/autismhealth.com%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2FAutism-Health-Press-Release.pdf/b43o/MzbEAQ/AQ/c1cc1bc8-a8ff-44a9-988c-97509dbd06c9/3/OX0Jm_yEr_?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID) for more informaiton on our partnerships with CPI and Dr. Goodenowe.

To celebrate the final countdown, we are offering a special $50 discount on in-person tickets. Use promo code Autism50 at checkout.

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID)
https://ahsconference.com/?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI), Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises, European Wellness, and Satellite Phone Store. Their commitment helps make this event possible and supports ongoing education and outreach within the autism community.

We also extend our sincere thanks to our Silver, Health, and Wellness Sponsors whose generosity and shared mission strengthen this work, including Functional Genomic Analysis, Neuro Needs, Microbiome Research Foundation, NutraMedix, Relax Saunas, MAHA Action, Best EMF Products, ARCC Center, Children's Health Defense, myMico Lab, Life Wave and Brain Tap, Daylight Computer Company, Weston A. Price Foundation, VibraTec Plates, Sun Power LED, Stalwart Law Group, Doniparthi Neurogen Academy, Kadiant, Algonot, Informed Policy Advocates, Micronic Silver, SPELLERS, Spectrum Sciences LLC, The Wellness Blanket, Xlear, Vicar Venetia, Sabre Defense Team, Pur Health, LLC, Warrior Mom, Purium, C-Polar Technologies, OxyHealth, Solex AO Scan, Pulse PEMF, MAPS, PatchMD, CelWel, ReligenDX, and Physicians for Informed Consent.

Most sponsorship levels are sold out, but we have a limited number of Wellness Sponsorships still available for those interested in exhibiting. For more information about becoming a sponsor, email us at info@autismhealth.com (mailto:info@autismhealth.com) .
SPONSORSHIP REGISTRATION (https://ahsconference.com/sponsors/?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID)

Join Us for Our Monthly Autism Support Group!
https://autismhealth.com/support/?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID

We invite you to join our upcoming Autism Support Group on Wednesday, April 1, 2026 at 5:00 PM PST / 8:00 PM EST. This virtual gathering is a welcoming space for parents, caregivers, and individuals navigating autism and related neurological conditions to come together in community.

Our support group is designed to provide connection, encouragement, and shared learning. Whether you are just beginning your journey or have years of experience, this is a place to ask questions, share insights, and gain support from others who understand.

Register using the link below to receive access details.

We look forward to connecting with you.
REGISTER HERE (https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/hMAFdOSASdqV-G25WcswRA?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID#/registration)

About Autism Health Inc.
Autism Health is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to educating individuals, families, and communities about autism spectrum disorder (ASD). Autism Health provides educational programs, workshops, events, research, and resources tailored to meet the diverse needs of those impacted by autism and other neurological disorders.
DONATE HERE (https://autismhealth.com/donations/?mc_cid=39ee1e3167&mc_eid=UNIQID)
Autism Health Inc. depends on generous donations from our community. Large or small, every donation gets us closer to achieving our goals. We are grateful for your assistance! For more information about Autism Health, visit www.AutismHealth.com

| Dear Peter,
Today, we recognize an extraordinary chapter coming to a close.
After more than three decades of service, House Minority Leader Brad Jones has announced he will not seek re-election.
Brad Jones has served his constituents, the communities he represents, and the Republican Party with steadfast dedication and integrity for over three decades. Leader Jones will leave an indelible imprint on the body he has represented that will not soon be replaced. The Republican Party of Massachusetts is grateful for his service.
His commitment to public service, principled leadership, and thoughtful governance has earned him the admiration of colleagues on both sides of the aisle.
Please, join me in thanking him for his extraordinary service and wishing him all the best in the next chapter!
---
|
---
Sincerely,
---
|
---
| Amy Carnevale Chair, Massachusetts Republican Party

| REPRESENTATIVE BRADLEY JONES ANNOUNCES HE WILL NOT SEEK RE-ELECTION TO THE MASSACHUSETTS HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
After 32 years serving in the House of Representatives, I have decided that I will not seek re-election to another term this fall.
Serving as State Representative has been a tremendously meaningful part of my life, and while difficult to leave behind, I eagerly look forward to my next chapter. It is a profound and distinct honor for which I will be eternally grateful. Representing the community where I was born and raised has made this even more of a privilege.
Thank you to my constituents for allowing me to serve them for over three decades, electing me 17 times. I am very proud to have maintained my perfect voting record since I first took the oath of office on March 22, 1994. As of last count, it is over 8,180 roll call votes. I believe this is a reflection of my commitment to my constituents.
I have served and worked with many extraordinary local public officials, community volunteers, and committed advocates over the years. Together, we have brought countless local initiatives and projects to completion, improving the facilities and services across the district. Thank you for welcoming me into your homes, inviting me into your neighborhoods, letting me celebrate milestones with you, and including me in community celebrations throughout my four towns.
My colleagues in the Republican caucus have afforded me the rare privilege to serve as Minority Leader since 2002, allowing me to be even more impactful in my service. Working with so many talented and dedicated members, often across the aisle, on a wide range of important issues over the years has been rewarding and inspiring.
I have been extremely fortunate to have had so many remarkable staff members support me over the years. Constituent service has always been paramount, and together, we have assisted thousands of residents and helped them navigate state agencies.
Until my term concludes next January, I will continue to represent the people of Lynnfield, Middleton, North Reading, & Reading with the same commitment and passion. Thank you again for the honor of representing the 20th Middlesex District and the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
---
| | | | Massachusetts Republican Party | 85 Merrimac Street Suite 505 | Boston, MA 02114 US

# Markets rally as Trump pauses Iran power plant strikes
President Trump **[delayed planned U.S. strikes on Iran's power plants](https://substack.com/redirect/754ccd20-e608-4929-af30-b62997d04088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and energy infrastructure for five days after claiming productive talks toward ending Middle East hostilities, though Iran denied negotiations.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/754ccd20-e608-4929-af30-b62997d04088?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Ultimatum on Strait Issued** : Trump gave Iran 48 hours to reopen Hormuz or face strikes, with postponement tied to ongoing discussions he called intense and deal-focused.
**Iran Denies Talks** : Senior official stated no negotiation occurred or will occur, warning psychological warfare prevents Hormuz recovery or energy market peace.
**Infrastructure Destruction Risk** : Iranian speaker warned attacks could irreversibly destroy critical energy facilities across Persian Gulf, with over 40 Middle East assets already severely damaged.
**Market Relief Rally** : Stocks rallied, dollar fell, oil tumbled, and precious metals pared losses following the strike postponement announcement.

# Oil Plunges 13% on Trump's Iran strike hold
Oil prices[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ff580ca5-0ab8-4ec8-90c8-9ea6d4f13ec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[tumbled sharply after President Trump halted U.S. strikes](https://substack.com/redirect/ff580ca5-0ab8-4ec8-90c8-9ea6d4f13ec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Iranian energy sites for five days amid productive talks, sending Brent crude down over 13% to $96.91 and WTI to $85.66 from recent highs above $112.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ff580ca5-0ab8-4ec8-90c8-9ea6d4f13ec6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Strait of Hormuz Flows Critical** : Key chokepoint normally carries 20% of global oil supplies but currently at just 5% of normal due to war disruptions and threats.
**IEA Releases Record Stockpiles** : Member nations agreed March 11 to release 400 million barrels from strategic reserves to counter supply shock from Iran conflict.
**Goldman Upgrades Forecasts** : Bank sees Brent averaging $110 in March/April if Hormuz flows stay low, with potential to exceed 2008 record highs of ~$147 if 5% flows persist 10 weeks.
**IEA Chief Warns Severity** : Situation far worse than 1970s oil shocks plus Russia-Ukraine gas impact combined, with more releases possible if strait remains closed.

# Gold pares losses as Trump pauses Iran strikes
Gold **[pared sharp declines Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/02a4d9f6-3240-45fc-b21d-eb26cd841b90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after President Trump postponed U.S. strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure for five days following productive talks, easing Middle East tensions and prompting a rebound in spot prices and silver.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/02a4d9f6-3240-45fc-b21d-eb26cd841b90?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Risk Asset Behavior Emerges** : Gold trades like a risk asset during broad risk-off periods, with extreme pro-cyclical moves despite heavy momentum and retail buying over the past six months.
**Productive Talks Announced** : Trump posted that U.S.-Iran conversations were very good regarding full resolution of Middle East hostilities, suspending escalation plans pending ongoing discussions.
**Dash for Cash Pressures** : Investors sold liquid positions amid the conflict, while surging energy prices raise Fed rate hike odds and strengthen the dollar, pressuring non-yielding bullion.
**Historical Precedent Clear** : Previous shocks in 2008, 2020, and 2022 saw initial gold drops from dollar demand, followed by sustained rallies after macro adjustments.
* * *
* * *
# Gold miners squeezed by plunging prices and soaring energy
Gold prices fell 1.3% to $4,432.09/oz Monday **[as investors ditched the safe-haven](https://substack.com/redirect/4a21ff88-2ad5-4dff-a5b1-cf9003f8eb4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** metal amid the ongoing Iran war, squeezing miner margins with lower revenues and higher energy costs from the oil/gas supply shock.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57d5384d-2cf6-40ae-9ac1-0322a9498cd9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Bull Run Reversal Hits Hard** : VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) rose nearly 200% in 2025 but shed gains, down 27% year-to-date despite trading up 4.12% intraday at 83.42.
**Margins Crushed Dual Sides** : Lower gold revenues reduce income while war-driven energy price surge raises production costs, threatening miner profitability similar to 2006-07.
**Investor Profit-Taking Emerges** : Recent rally provided base for gains realization, especially in smaller miners, amid asset allocation shifts from heightened uncertainty and geopolitical risk.
**Recovery Hinges Sentiment** : Miners unlikely to resume bullish path without improved risk sentiment and restored global growth confidence, given heavy exposure to economic shocks.
* * *
* * *
# GLP-1 drugs reshape restaurant menus
Weight-loss drugs like Ozempic drive Americans to eat 21% fewer calories and dine out less, **[prompting restaurants to add protein- and fiber-rich options](https://substack.com/redirect/0f4a6e24-15b1-4235-bec5-9910a742d5a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while shrinking portions to retain GLP-1 users.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0f4a6e24-15b1-4235-bec5-9910a742d5a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Calorie and Spending Drop** : Users spend nearly a third less on groceries, with 60% dining out less frequently and up to 45% fewer restaurant visits per surveys.
**Snacking and Alcohol Decline** : 70% of calorie reducers snack less, 45% drink less alcohol, shifting to yogurt, nuts, fruit over chips, impacting breakfast and dinner traffic.
**Protein Fiber Focus Emerges** : Companies launch protein-packed Doritos, cold foam, grab-and-go cups, and fiber-rich popcorn; restaurants offer lighter entrees and mini meals.
**Massive User Growth Projected** : One in eight U.S. adults currently on GLP-1s, potentially over 30 million by 2030, risking $30-55 billion annual food sales loss.

Sacrifice comes with a cost
| Dear Friend,
---
When offered a taxpayer-funded pension for serving as Mayor of the largest city in America, I said **_“NO!”_**
---
Much like President Trump who refuses a presidential salary, I view the position of Mayor as _public_ service – not some get-rich, self-serving scheme like Nancy Pelosi and the Biden Crime Family.
---
Today that pension would help me pay my legal bills to stay out of jail as an innocent man! It would cover basic living expenses after I was forced to sell my home.
---
But nevertheless, I did the _right_ thing. _Service to the American public trumps service to self_.
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z54re3ov543amgnhn1juq0r9h5t2eos93n3i1030_rp22sh2s8i6epr1cpg68ob6cdh2bs)

---
**_Now, I want to make myself absolutely clear, which is why I am putting this line in bold AND underlining it!_**
---
I don’t want you to feel even an _ounce_ of guilt to donate. If you cannot give, please don’t think twice. Sacrifice comes with a cost, and I knew full well the consequences of refusing a pension.
---
And the truth is: _I will find a way_. My entire life has been about finding a way. They said I couldn’t clean up New York, take down the Mafia, and help President Trump get justice – and yet, _I did!_
---
3 years ago, I was named Prisoner # **_01135780_** in the most violent jail in America alongside my friend and former client.

**_Think about how much has changed! Now, I’ve got a fighting chance for _FREEDOM_._**

It’s been a busy couple of weeks on the campaign trail – and we didn’t want any member of Team Warner to miss out on the action.

Election season is heating up in Virginia. The work continues to hold President Trump and his administration accountable. And we’ve been on the road talking to voters and community leaders.

_Keep reading for all the latest updates and ways to stay involved during this important moment for our country!_ **Stopping the “SAVE” Act** This week, the Senate will continue voting on Trump’s so-called “SAVE” Act – the most blatant attempt at voter suppression in ages. It discriminates against servicemembers, married women, rural Americans, and anyone else who doesn’t have a passport or their birth certificate on hand.

**It has _nothing_ to do with making our elections more secure and _everything_ to do with pleasing a president who can’t accept that he lost the 2020 election.**

And it’s long past time for Warner’s Republican colleagues to admit that and stand up to President Trump.

[**_Will you join Senator Warner and call on Republicans to STOP caving to Trump’s demands and protect our right to vote? It’s one small action to take today to keep up the fight against Republicans’ voter suppression tactics >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127903963/609592827/-1737537216?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260323_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260323_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjliMmNlZC1kZTI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dSYuD353rYzqL5aR7axUq_sGTnSgdsDZTwiNvRNdIwY=&emci=99e2aa71-cd26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=269b2ced-de26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=4568237) ******[ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127903964/609592828/-1737537216?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260323_T1_1&ms=MW_ATA_EM_FR_Newsletter_260323_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjliMmNlZC1kZTI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dSYuD353rYzqL5aR7axUq_sGTnSgdsDZTwiNvRNdIwY=&emci=99e2aa71-cd26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=269b2ced-de26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=4568237)****** **On the road in rural Virginia** Stopping the SAVE Act is just one of the many conversations we had with voters on the road this month.

Senator Warner _officially_ kicked off his reelection campaign the same way he has started every other campaign: with a tour through Southwest and rural Virginia.

We started in Castlewood, Virginia, where Senator Warner hosted a roundtable discussion focused on supporting coal miners and advancing the fight against Black Lung disease. clean_body: | | | = Derek, It’s been a busy couple of weeks on the campaign trail – and we didn’t want any member of Team Warner to miss out on the action. Election season is heating up in Virginia. The work continues to hold President Trump and his administration accountable. And we’ve been on the road talking to voters and community leaders. Keep reading for all the latest updates and ways to stay involved during this important moment for our country! Stopping the “SAVE” Act This week, the Senate will continue voting on Trump’s so-called “SAVE” Act – the most blatant attempt at voter suppression in ages. It discriminates against servicemembers, married women, rural Americans, and anyone else who doesn’t have a passport or their birth certificate on hand. It has nothing to do with making our elections more secure and everything to do with pleasing a president who can’t accept that he lost the 2020 election. And it’s long past time for Warner’s Republican colleagues to admit that and stand up to President Trump. ****** On the road in rural Virginia Stopping the SAVE Act is just one of the many conversations we had with voters on the road this month. Senator Warner officially kicked off his reelection campaign the same way he has started every other campaign: with a tour through Southwest and rural Virginia. We started in Castlewood, Virginia, where Senator Warner hosted a roundtable discussion focused on supporting coal miners and advancing the fight against Black Lung disease. He continued on to Abingdon for his FIRST campaign rally of the election. | = | = ---|--- Warner’s kick off tour continued on with stops in Marion, Wytheville, Pulaski, Roanoke, Farmville and more: = | = ---|--- = And completed with a stop in Richmond, where Senator Warner filed for reelection. = And we’re off... Now that Warner’s officially on the ballot in Virginia this year, the work has truly just begun! Our team is planning our next big campaign tour, making critical investments into voter outreach, and building a team of hundreds of volunteers to help reelect Mark Warner and support Democrats in every corner of Virginia. The best time to get involved is now – and there are so many ways you can help: Volunteer with Virginia Democrats: If you live in Virginia, you can use this form to sign up to join our Virtual Field Office – and a member of our team will be in touch soon with opportunities to get involved! **** Spread the word: Getting our message out to voters and supporters starts with YOU. Watch our latest campaign video and then share on social media or send directly to your friends, family, or neighbors! **** Chip in to help fund Senator Warner’s reelection effort: Donations from grassroots supporters like you fuel our campaign – and make everything we do possible. And the truth is, the earlier you donate, the bigger impact your donation will have on the outcome of the midterms in Virginia. **=** Thank you for your ongoing support! Whether you sign up to volunteer, share our content online, or donate what you can, please know you’re making a difference during this unprecedented time in our country. Your support means the world to Senator Warner and all of us on Team Warner. name: Matias, United We Dream
subject: Turning anger and grief into tangible love and solidarity
body:
We’re living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 14-year history. | | | Peter, **** United We Dream members are organizing their communities to write letters to immigrants in detention to remind them they’re not alone. We know that **love and dignity for immigrants in detention comes from us, the people**. It starts with empathy, care, and something as simple as a letter: something that says _we see you, we hear you, and we are with you_. [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAesyy1ml4hxyp2tJ_Fo3Ip6EGA195x0ZSzYHHukZILfGnoIAr11DoVdn30OCsBjP-Gb7sWekDoCVZm2m1E4JMaqLKcnsdLzfZXpso9Qz6l_MbEnLDw7jVZRBcK6skU5XaAmyWvPk3uR9hwbtpOOHrBu6UB8JQzniuvWNCUiwS3bo3DodiPevYtnjqkBGGuKSBTdbopByvy0f1xw9BLDcJRQWXGyyiWI1-7IMY0O5ap7270EjctRQZFjjXLpe78d_k-_YTBrObwvBLUCuk5yvBxeR1UncKVt3EbeqFFRSpcat4pq4ZW6EquXMkM9APhXjnOmgyZGxElT0wSySLJ7ZofNoXJ-PS5mTz8t_IPsn6KRAZQBmWf8xgDXZTaT53-d0pRMfK7plFut-_gD0hxS6JJ3DkWsVNCt3pB1R_jiJxL4WbLx9lJ58emADnADg5S9iPGtXRyOevHDCUa0KTXwkO-AQ/4p6/eyfW84umRiGNd0kk252Fug/h0/h001.WM6pFR-b90I6RR8XKUNTwOuB0xseHx9f80xSjpAAicY) So far, members have written 300 letters at gatherings across the country. A local attorney hosted a letter writing party for her daughter and her friends in their first year of high school. Another member gathered the family together at a Valentine’s Day party to send messages of hope. And one of our high school students organized an event where participants wrote _120_ letters to people in detention. We, the people, can raise our voices so that people enduring abuse and inhumane conditions know that we’re rooting for their freedom and dignity. **Together, we can fight against a system designed to clean_body: We’re living through the most dangerous moment in DACA’s 14-year history. | | | Peter, ** United We Dream members are organizing their communities to write letters to immigrants in detention to remind them they’re not alone. We know that love and dignity for immigrants in detention comes from us, the people. It starts with empathy, care, and something as simple as a letter: something that says we see you, we hear you, and we are with you. So far, members have written 300 letters at gatherings across the country. A local attorney hosted a letter writing party for her daughter and her friends in their first year of high school. Another member gathered the family together at a Valentine’s Day party to send messages of hope. And one of our high school students organized an event where participants wrote 120 letters to people in detention. We, the people, can raise our voices so that people enduring abuse and inhumane conditions know that we’re rooting for their freedom and dignity. Together, we can fight against a system designed to isolate people and offer connection, care, and hope through the written word. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. _People don 't like corporations telling them what they should see and like._
Dear Valued Subscriber and Movie & Music Lovers,
The 97th Academy Awards (2025) drew 19.69 million viewers, marking a five-year high, aided by streaming on Hulu and a 1% increase from 2024. While viewership has slowly recovered from a 2021 low, it remains significantly below the 1998 peak of 55 million. People don't like corporations telling them what they should see and like.
Michael B. Jordan won the Oscar for Best Actor at the 98th Academy Awards for his dual role as twins Smoke and Stack in the vampire drama **Sinners**. During his Oscar speech, Jordan paid tribute to previous Black acting winners, naming Sidney Poitier, Denzel Washington, Halle Berry, Jamie Foxx, Forest Whitaker, and Will Smith. All of them were fan favorites long before Oscar acknowledged their hard work.
**Sinners** (2025) has become a major box office success, grossing over $369 million worldwide ($279.9M domestic) against a $100 million budget. The Ryan Coogler-directed horror thriller achieved the highest opening for an original film in 6 years ($48M), eventually becoming the highest-grossing original domestic release in 15 years.
**[Vote Now in the Heartland AwardsTM ->](https://substack.com/redirect/edbb0ce5-2f19-4743-894a-52fba44c0f6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Michael B. earned three Actor Awards and a Producers Guild Award, in addition to nominations for a British Academy Film Award, a Golden Globe Award, and two Emmy Awards. An amazing accomplishment for a young man whose breakout film moment came with **Fruitvale Station** (2013) -- Budget: $900,000. Box office: $17.4 million. The film debuted at the 2013 Sundance Film Festival. He and his film were fan favorites, but ignored by the Academy.
The 2026 Sundance Film Festival, held in January, marks the final edition of the event in Park City, Utah, after a 40-plus-year run -- closing a major chapter in independent film history.
_" It's hard not to feel a disturbance in the force,"_ said Ethan Hawke, whose acting career took off after his early movies appeared at the Utah festival in the 1990s.
End of an era for independent, heartland, artistic film discovery.

I was born and raised on the South Side of Chicago, and service has always been at the heart of who I am. My mom was a public school teacher. My dad, a Navy veteran, was a doctor in community health. They taught me that when you see a need, you step up. That’s exactly what I’ve done — first as an advocate for criminal justice reform, then as a state representative, and now as Lieutenant Governor alongside Governor Pritzker.
But I’m not just a politician. I’m a mom who raised a family while caring for my mother as she battled Alzheimer’s, so I know firsthand the struggles working people face. That’s why every day, I wake up committed to ensuring that every Illinoisan — no matter their ZIP code, background, or income — has the chance to thrive.
But Trump and his allies? They are doing the opposite. They’re waging war on working families to bankroll their tax breaks and ignoring our needs to look out for their own. Too many politicians in Washington are afraid to fight back, but I refuse to just stand by and watch.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need fighters in the nation’s capital. These aren’t normal times, and we need leaders who will bring new ideas and new perspectives to Washington.**
For decades, politicians have made empty promises to working families on the campaign trail that never materialized into solutions. Not in Illinois. Governor Pritzker and I didn’t just talk about solutions — we delivered them. We raised the minimum wage, protected reproductive freedoms, made our communities safer from gun violence, relieved millions in medical debt, and made education a priority — even when members of our own party thought progress wasn’t possible.
That’s the fight we’re leading here in Illinois and the fight I will bring to Washington. Working people deserve a champion who doesn't just talk — but delivers. I will be that leader, but I can’t get there alone.
MAGA special interests have already spent more than $10 million attacking me during our primary. Now, they’re preparing to double down to stop our movement for working people from reaching Washington.
We can’t afford to lose momentum or slow down — not when more attacks are on the way.

Juliana Stratton

subject: When I’m governor, I’ll make this right
body:
Our kids deserve better than this.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260323_1_education.FKhJbo&refcode=em20260323-798&t=1&akid=798%2E299639%2Eq8TlkH)
**This is wrong, Peter. And when I’m governor, I’m going to fix it.**
Public school students are subjected to deeply flawed standardized tests while private school students get a free pass — _and_ a taxpayer-funded school voucher.
If the STAAR test is good enough for the 5.5 million kids in Texas public schools, it should be good enough for _ALL_ students receiving a taxpayer-funded education.
And if it’s not — then _NO_ student in Texas should be subjected to these tests.
When I’m governor, we’re going to end the **STAAR testing regime** as we know it and **stop the voucher scheme** that’s draining resources from our public schools.
[**Pitch in $5 to help me beat Greg Abbott and fight for public education.**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260323_1_education.FKhJbo&refcode=em20260323-798&amount=5&t=2&akid=798%2E299639%2Eq8TlkH)
I’ve seen what our public schools can do when they’re supported — and I’ve seen what happens when politicians rig the system against them. I ran for office the first time to stop politicians from shutting down my son’s school. And we won that fight.
Today, politicians like Greg Abbott are threatening public education at every turn:
* Over-testing our kids
* Undermining our teachers
* Defunding our neighborhood schools
* Handing public dollars to private interests with no real accountability

**Texas kids deserve better. Plain and simple.**
And I’m running for governor because I know we can deliver on that promise.
We’re going to end the era of the STAAR test. We’re going to roll back Abbott’s voucher scheme that funds private school education with our taxpayer dollars.
**If you believe every student in Texas deserves a quality public education, I’m with you. That’s the future I’ll fight for as your next governor.[Will you pitch in $5 or anything you can to help me defeat Greg Abbott this November?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260323_1_education.FKhJbo&refcode=em20260323-798&amount=5&t=3&akid=798%2E299639%2Eq8TlkH)**

Thank you,
Gina

**This fight isn’t easy, but it’s worth it. And I’m not going anywhere.**

Will you stand with me?
