subject: The Affordable Care Act is a lifeline
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRISTINA BOHANNAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
When I was younger and my dad was kicked off our insurance, the effects on my family were devastating.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127907813/609606042/-975735282?refcode=em_logoheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDA1ZTg1Yy1lYTI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FzRkYZ6Cgd572QkDwZMWYXKpYqEm-t947trs5xpvQKE=)

Peter,

Sixteen years ago today, the Affordable Care Act (ACA) was officially signed into law, and for 40 million Americans, everything changed.

It meant working families could finally afford care. It meant small businesses could take care of their employees. It meant that having a preexisting condition no longer made you uninsurable. **Legislation like this is exactly why having strong leaders in Congress is so important.**

When I was younger, and my dad was kicked off our insurance, the effects on my family were devastating. My family had to constantly choose between paying bills and affording my dad's care. I know we were just one of many families in the country thrust into that kind of devastation. Today, I'm grateful that so _many_ families don't have to endure the same hardship because of the Affordable Care Act.

Unfortunately, the very people elected to protect our healthcare are trying to strip us of this lifeline, including Mariannette Miller-Meeks.

She’s let ACA tax credits expire, sending premiums skyrocketing for working families. She voted to strip Medicaid coverage from over 100,000 Iowans, leaving them without care. And when asked about rising healthcare costs? She said she’s fine with them staying high because maybe then people will **“make better life choices.”**

**That's not what real leadership is about.**

Here’s what I believe, and what I will always fight for: Healthcare isn’t a reward for perfect behavior. Everyone deserves affordable, accessible care. We’ve fought too hard and come too far to regress, but I need your help to make sure it doesn't happen.

**[If you believe healthcare should be accessible, affordable, and protected, will you chip in to my campaign? Help me defeat Miller-Meeks and protect healthcare for Iowa families today.>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127907814/609606043/-2011951990?refcode=em26_260323_FRACA_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260323_FRACA_fnd_gq_act___CB_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=fd05e85c-ea26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmZDA1ZTg1Yy1lYTI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FzRkYZ6Cgd572QkDwZMWYXKpYqEm-t947trs5xpvQKE=)**

Thank you,

Christina

A self-funder spent millions trying to buy this race. Texans said not so fast. |
_**Are you still with me, Fellow Patriot?**_

Nearly two million Texans cast a ballot in the Republican Primary for Attorney General - and thanks to the grassroots, we're headed to a runoff.

_But let's be honest about what happened in the first round._

My opponent tried to buy this race outright.

He poured more than $16 million of his own money into the campaign and outspent us **_3 to 1_** just to reach **_39%_** of the vote.

clean_body: A self-funder spent millions trying to buy this race. Texans said not so fast. | Are you still with me, Fellow Patriot? Nearly two million Texans cast a ballot in the Republican Primary for Attorney General - and thanks to the grassroots, we're headed to a runoff. But let's be honest about what happened in the first round. My opponent tried to buy this race outright. He poured more than $16 million of his own money into the campaign and outspent us 3 to 1 just to reach 39% of the vote. On top of that, a left-wing California PAC spent millions attacking me because they're furious about my work with President Trump to rip hundreds of billions of dollars in Green New Scam subsidies out of the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." They thought enough money could drown out the truth. They were wrong. Because Texans know something that the political class and out-of-state donors don't: Now the runoff begins - and the stakes couldn't be higher. The Attorney General of Texas must be ready on DAY ONE to defend our state against: A broken immigration system and open-border policies Hostile foreign nations buying Texas land The growing threat of radical Islam A future Democratic administration trying to reopen the floodgates of illegal immigration This job isn't a stepping stone. It's the Chief Legal Officer for the largest conservative state in America. It requires someone who has actually fought the battles - in Congress, in the courts, and for the Constitution. My opponent has never spent a day in a courtroom. And now he's preparing to spend even more millions trying to buy the runoff. If the grassroots steps up again - if Texans show that this race belongs to the people, not the highest bidder - we will win this runoff. Because at the end of the day, the message is simple: Texas is not for sale. Let's finish what we started. subject: Affordable care is out of reach for many
body:
| | Peter, I deeply understand the struggles working families in Southwest Washington face – because I’ve faced them myself.

Before I was elected to Congress, my husband Dean and I could only afford health insurance for our son, because the additional $1200 a month to cover ourselves was simply out of our budget.

Programs like the Affordable Care Act (ACA), which was enacted 16 years ago this week, have allowed millions of Americans to obtain health insurance and care they previously couldn’t afford. **This was a huge step forward, but serious problems remain with how our healthcare systems operate.**

I won’t stop fighting to expand access and lower costs for rural communities, veterans, and working families across Southwest Washington because all of us deserve access to affordable, quality health care.

I have worked hard to increase access to affordable care for rural communities, veterans and working families across Southwest Washington by _spearheading bipartisan legislation to restore critical health care transportation services for veterans, increasing telehealth opportunities through expanded rural broadband access, and lowering costs by going after harmful middlemen who enrich themselves by jacking up the price of prescription drugs._

I’ve said it before – I won’t sit by and wait for someone else to fix the problems we face and honestly, who better to advocate for working families in Washington than a working mother who knows the struggle to afford health care like me.

The months ahead are going to be hard as we face another tough re-election battle, but I won’t be distracted. I’m determined to keep making progress on this and so many other issues that impact the day to day lives of the Southwest Washington community I call home.

[If you’re with me, please donate $10 or whatever you can afford to support my continued fight.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127909135/609611356/1707133330?amount=10&refcode=MGP_EM_FR_90DO_260323_1_1&refcode2=d512cd98-eb26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNTEyY2Q5OC1lYjI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MhgMttGzLBrjhfx53h8FtEgKDgSodnpkqR5YPMs_PlY=)

She is dedicated to educating Christians about their role in the civic arena and to helping families build a lasting legacy that secures freedom for future generations. Tennessee Stands purpose statement says it all. We educate, equip and empower all citizens to boldly assert their unalienable rights given to us all, not by man, but naturally by God. body:
#

Peter -
Thanks to your help, Ruben's fighting for us in the United States Senate.
He knows what it's like to face down a tough election. And as we organize in advance of the critical elections in November, there is no one more committed to supporting the candidates we need to win than Ruben.
Ruben enlisted in the Marine Corps and fought for this country in Iraq. He was ready to fight for it again on January 6th. And he will be on the frontline of the fight in the years ahead.
As he works to defend our communities, deliver for the people of Arizona, and win back majorities in Congress in November, he’s going to need your help again. **So, we’re respectfully asking you to sign on and personally endorse Ruben Gallego.**
[**Will you add your name to say that you’re ready to fight alongside Ruben? He would be honored if you would renew your support.** [ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/signup/personal_endorse_em_260323/?source=em260323-1-90&akid=4097%2E734936%2Egov25o) With so much happening, it might seem like adding your name is a small, insignificant act. But with thousands joining you it adds up to something far larger. When you add your name you’re helping support Ruben as he defends our democracy and fights to deliver real results to improve people’s lives through his work in the Senate. It’s important. Really. So thank you in advance for adding your name. Team Gallego

**When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school.** Most kids in that situation fall apart. **But not Nancy.** **I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -__how you rise does.__ ** She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: **
👉** Never quit.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | Hi, This is Brigadier General James Emory Mace, U.S. Army (Retired). Today, I write to you not as a soldier... but as a father. I’m a Vietnam War Veteran and Purple Heart Medal recipient. I’ve worn the uniform. I’ve buried friends who never made it home. And I’ve felt the sting of a Nation that sometimes forgets what our sacrifices were for. But my daughter - Congresswoman Nancy Mace - never forgot. Nancy was raised in the shadow of the flag. She saw the uniform. She lived with the deployments. She knew the cost. And instead of running from it, she ran toward it. That’s the kind of person -the kind of fighter \- she is. When Nancy was 17, she dropped out of high school. Most kids in that situation fall apart. But not Nancy. I raised her to believe that setbacks don’t define you -how you rise does. She grew up hearing the same lessons over and over again: 👉 Never quit. 👉 Never run from the truth.👉 And never let anyone tell you thatyou are less than what God made you to be. So I gave her a choice: She picked herself up, took a job at Waffle House, and fought her way back. By 21, she became the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, following in my footsteps. Soon after, she was elected as the first woman to represent South Carolina in the U.S. House of Representatives. She’s been fighting her whole life; for herself, for her kids, for the truth, and now...for her state. Nancy led an evacuation mission in the Middle East after learning a South Carolina family was stranded. Because when your people are stuck in a war zone getting hit with missiles and rockets, the only answer worthy of the office -worthy of our country \- is to get them out. She flew into an active war zone and answered the call when Americans needed help. As a father - and as a Purple Heart Veteran \- I’ve never been more proud of my daughter. That’s why it’s hard when I have to watch Nancy face relentless attacks day after day. Each day that goes out there and fights for you, she’s up against the Establishment’s knife. They stalk her. Send her death threats. She’s even been physically assaulted. But Nancy is my daughter. And I know this: She never backs down. And she never stops fighting. I want to ask you something from one parent, one patriot, to another: Will you support my daughter in the toughest battle of her life? But even in the face of all that, Nancy stood up for me. 👉 She stood up for EVERY veteran who was forgotten. 👉 She stood up for stranded American families and rescued them from an active Middle East warzone.👉 She stood up when other Republicans stayed silent. And now, she’s standing up for YOU. But she needs your backup. I may not wear the uniform anymore, but I still believe in answering the call. Will you answer it with me today? Nancy’s not running to make friends. She’s running to win. To fight. To serve. That’s what she learned growing up in our home. That’s what she learned watching me go off to war. body:
A rescue team changed Kristen’s life. Another mission begins in Phoenix.

| [View in Web Browser](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e7951486/VaHR0cHM6Ly93cm8ubnVjbGV1c2VtYWlsLmNvbS9hbXBsaWZ5L3YvRGhLVTROWmdVSA/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNjAzMjM/LbmNsZXpCU3lueg/qP2hpZHM9bmNNbHJTR21BSWxLcGdscw/gacGTCQ/scr0c9d25df)
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| |
---
| GOD'S CHILDREN ARE NOT FOR SALE
---
|
---
| | Friend, No one could hear her. A young girl named Kristen was locked in an attic. No windows. No fresh air. No way out. The door was locked from the outside. For months she lived there.
Alone. There was no bathroom.
Just a bucket. No shower. No clean clothes. And the only time she left that attic was when she was sold for sex.
Over. And over. And over. **This is the reality of child trafficking.**
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
[ Send help to children waiting ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Millions of children are trapped in exploitation around the world. But Kristen’s story did not end in that attic. One night she knocked on a hotel room door. Her trafficker had arranged and forced her into another “date.” But instead...**she met a rescue team - Freedom Strike Force.** They were working alongside law enforcement to identify victims and traffickers. When Kristen realized she was safe... She collapsed into the arms of one of our female advocates. **Free.** Law enforcement then raided the house where she was held. Traffickers were arrested. Kristen was taken to a safe place. For the first time in months, she had a real bed and a hot meal**.**

**She took the first step toward healing.** **This rescue was possible because people chose to act.**
---
[ Send help to children waiting ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
The **Sound of Freedom Foundation** exists to _stop_ ___the sale_ _of God’s children._ Inspired by the film _Sound of Freedom_ , the Foundation works around the world to **prevent trafficking, support rescue efforts, educate families, raise awareness, and push for stronger laws that protect children.** Our mission is simple. **To stop the sale of God’s children.** And right now we are preparing a new mission, happening in just a few weeks in Phoenix. Our **Freedom Strike Force** partner will train local law enforcement for two days, teaching them how to identify traffickers and victims hidden in plain sight. Then on day three...they go into the field. **Real operations. Real arrests. Real rescues.**
---
| | [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
| | Children like Kristen are waiting. But these missions cannot happen without support from people who care.
---
[ Send help to children waiting ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
That is why I am reaching out to you today. [](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**[Would you consider making your first gift of $30, $60, $130 or whatever you can do right now to help rescue children from trafficking?](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** Your donation today can help:
---
* Train officers to find trafficked children
* Support rescue operations
* Provide food, clothing, and care for survivors
* Help children begin the journey to healing

---
When I first heard the stories of trafficked children, I asked myself a question. _What if it were my child?_ I could not stay silent.
And you do not have to either. **Friend, will you please help rescue the next child today?** Your gift — whatever God places on your heart — will help bring freedom to children still waiting in the dark. **Together we can make sure more children hear the Sound of Freedom.** With gratitude and prayer,
---
[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
Eduardo Verástegui
Sound of Freedom, Producer
For the Sound of Freedom Foundation
---
**P.S.** The cost to staff, equip, and execute a **Freedom Strike Force** **Training Camp** is $25,000. To raise these funds, I need Freedom Fighters like you to rally in support and sponsor this mission.

**Please pray about what you can do to help and donate today.**
---
[ Support the Sound of Freedom Foundation ](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
---
6671 Southwest Freeway, Suite 700, Houston TX 77074
---

|
Peter,
Last year, Elon Musk tried to buy the Wisconsin Supreme Court.
He dropped record-shattering money into the race. It became a national story. Cable news ran it 24/7. Democrats across the country saw his face on their screens and rallied. They showed up, they donated, they voted, and they handed him one of the most humiliating defeats of his life.
We won. And we built a 4-3 liberal majority on one of the most important Supreme Courts in America.
This year, the race is just as consequential. Another seat is on the ballot on April 7. If we win, that majority jumps to 5-2 -- locked in through 2030, safe from anything Trump throws at it between now and the 2028 presidential election.
But Elon isn't writing the checks this time.
There's no villain, which means no outrage cycle, no national media storm, no army of motivated Democrats flooding in from out of state to defeat him.
And MAGA is counting on exactly that.

| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001UIKHh7_6a4GbnkWxyZbh-aFlzd38IpPNt7QN_Pxqm3Mq8ciws4Rm7DLLRGn73iU3f3mP1Xjmr9F3xlKM-g2q9DS-I_x0tPi8sVIJbcPRIHs-gSGjQUSn7UkNKpLUjsXZWxtx6l3sLSNqcfiyh0ziD9jMZ9YWkHyddvR3L0jI1mgen8n6N-te3K-ZClcPB-GTsJ3-NwvAvf5aoeIyLpLF3g2lucZiE5XJgAWx8Y5m9NA=&c=ygf-U5IZC5_iMPHU9gl8SJ69bfa_ByttT8tW6a4nryWG0gEVsv0yNA==&ch=xIrGp7xdYmpCi34Fplx2w6NmJ85wzyumNvIiM1KGMXEGAwdTZNygVw==)

While you're watching the news about Trump's war in Iran, airport chaos, and Democratic primaries, MAGA is quietly working to flip this court under the radar.
Their candidate, MAGA-extremist Maria Lazar, has ties to the fake elector scheme, the Big Lie, and the people Trump pardoned for trying to steal 2020 in Wisconsin.
If MAGA wins in April, they don't just pick up a seat. They could control this court heading into the 2028 presidential election.

Congratulations Friends!
We did it, we won the primary for the 11th Congressional District!
However, this merely marks the beginning of a significant undertaking. From day one, Bill Foster and his abysmal far-left record has been and will continue to be the focus. Bill Foster just voted against reopening the Department of Homeland Security; he voted against the SAVE America Act; he voted against the Home Energy Freedom Act; he voted against the Veterans Accessibility Advisory Committee Act; he voted against the Big Beautiful Bill; and as a true partisan he walked out on the State Union speech.
These kinds of votes and behavior are not what the peopleof the 11th Congressional District need in Washington, DC. I would have voted for each of these bills and would have stayed to participate in the State of the Union speech. The 11th Congressional District needs better representation.
Bill Foster has a war chest of almost $2.2 million. I need your help to raise the [$3.5 million](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=319ed54d0f&e=fa724b03ca) it will take to beat him. I have spent my life leading, serving, and getting the difficult jobs done as a Navy veteran, a mayor, and a manufacturing businessman. This is exactly the kind of leadership people are looking for right now. I will represent the people of the 11th Congressional District, with your help.
I need your support to get elected to Congress! Please help me by donating [$25](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=c182cd710d&e=fa724b03ca), [$50](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=f3895c92c5&e=fa724b03ca), [$100](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=b23823bffd&e=fa724b03ca), [$250](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=090552b3a0&e=fa724b03ca), [$500](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=84c37077da&e=fa724b03ca), [$1,000](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=8985561361&e=fa724b03ca), [$3,500](https://jeffwalterforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cd07e5cbd6f962285e423156e&id=9c56d1cccc&e=fa724b03ca).

_**By David Shuster**_
It is a rare and singular talent to turn one of history's gravest tragedies into a cheap and shallow punchline. But Donald Trump, in a performance that can only be described as a masterclass in political cringe, accomplished this feat in the White House Oval Office. Facing **Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi** of Japan, Old Man Orange reached for **Pearl Harbor** --as if it were a prop in a flimsy and awful TV show, and not the historic December morning in 1941 when Japan's surprise attack killed thousands and brought the United States into the global maelstrom of World War II.

Trump had been asked by a reporter about why Japan and other U.S. allies had received no advance notice of the U.S.-Israel assault on Iran.
"We didn't tell anybody about it because we wanted surprise," he said. "Who knows better about surprise than Japan, OK? Why didn't you tell me about Pearl Harbor, OK? Right?"
There was some laughter from some White House staff in the room. Trump then added, "you believe in surprise, I think, much more so than us."

* * *
The effect on anyone with a functioning front temporal lobe was instantaneous: shock, disbelief, and a sense of dread. Prime Minister Takaichi, schooled in diplomacy and etiquette, widened her eyes, shifted in her chair, and appeared to take a deep breath. She kept her arms crossed and did not speak. One could almost see her mental gears grinding. _Does Trump really think this is funny?_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/944d8389-daf0-4fe8-8849-e1922e25857e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
[ Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.NbE0DGIr7sUwWASGWqwxFigDEUGFC2GLnKuEg3I7lvs?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=191630924)
* * *
And never mind Trump invoking one of the most painful chapters in U.S.-Japan history, here is the absurdity: Trump's analogy is historically asinine. Pearl Harbor did not exemplify clever surprise tactics. It awakened a "sleeping giant" -- an industrial, military, and moral colossus that proceeded to crush Japan in a relentless campaign that ended in total defeat, firebombings, and atomic devastation. To invoke this historical moment as justification for keeping allies uninformed about military action in Iran is not just wrong; it is spectacularly wrong. It is like citing the eruption of Vesuvius to defend poor plumbing.
Trump, blissfully unaware of the historical and human context, smiled as if he had delivered a punchline worthy of applause.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0cd36070-5b04-45b0-b911-781291c08ace?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Yet any observer with even the faintest grasp of history or common sense could sense the room contracting, as though the very air had thickened with the weight of grotesque absurdity.
Pearl Harbor matters. It is a moment seared into the collective memory of nations, a lesson in hubris, intelligence failures, and the brutal arithmetic of war. Japan's gamble did not win admiration; it triggered the inexorable machinery of American industrial and military power. To wield it casually, to draw an analogy meant to justify secrecy and unilateralism, is an act of breathtaking idiocy. History, which often endures, must have paused and sighed in that moment, mortified.
* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=191630924&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkxNjMwOTI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzQyOTg1MTYsImV4cCI6MTc3Njg5MDUxNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.oMx7-dR102Zg9agUXnxcT51K_nRcYXjG2TJ12IxiG0g)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18c18dd9-f33a-4561-8631-d45ced5eee9e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Even by Trumpian standards -- standards which often resemble a carnival freak show more than the office of the U.S. presidency -- this was exceptional. Trump turned solemnity into slapstick, partnership into performance, and one of the gravest attacks in modern history into a bad joke, all to somehow boost Trump's grotesque ego. Diplomacy, trust, and decency were not merely strained; they were stomped into the carpet.
For the prime minister of Japan, her staff, and the citizens of Japan, the incident was surreal.
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=191630924&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkxNjMwOTI0LCJpYXQiOjE3NzQyOTg1MTYsImV4cCI6MTc3Njg5MDUxNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.oMx7-dR102Zg9agUXnxcT51K_nRcYXjG2TJ12IxiG0g&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/56e26e75-6d49-4c01-82cd-9fc9535d0298?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Indeed for anybody else with a functioning brain, the embarrassment radiated off Trump like heat from a dying sun, leaving the oval office in a haze of awkwardness so intense it might have been measurable in joules.
In the annals of diplomatic gaffes, this moment will endure -- not for insight or even for its audacity, but rather for the sheer, unrelieved horror of it. A prime minister of a proud, educated nation that is a dependable U.S. ally, was confronted by a spectacle so graceless that history itself seemed to flinch. And those of us fortunate enough to possess even a modicum of basic brain functioning, could only sit back, helpless, and shiver at the calamity of it all.
Yes, Trump will persist, and the world will continue to endure him. But some days, some moments, are so painfully ill-conceived that they deserve to be remembered.
History is not a joke. Alliances are built on trust not theatrics. And Trump's Pearl Harbor analogy was beyond absurd. It was offensive. It was historically illiterate. And, above all, it was agonizingly, excruciatingly, cringeworthy.

Hey team, I published an op-ed in the _[Boston Globe](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127910457/609615825/-177738211?refcode=260323_sm_op&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmJmNjg1ZC1mMDI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jcxJiFF9GvFOJ_3UwL3dFTC5tFhZuPOWARo_0asTCxQ=&emci=f343caf5-d326-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=c6bf685d-f026-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=194769)_ on Friday about something I’ve carried with me since my time serving in Iraq. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127910460/609615827/2090747700?refcode=260323_sm_op_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmJmNjg1ZC1mMDI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jcxJiFF9GvFOJ_3UwL3dFTC5tFhZuPOWARo_0asTCxQ=) 23 years ago, George Bush sent me and my fellow Marines to Iraq based on lies. I remember how quickly things moved, how the case was made, how the decision was taken, and how little clarity there was about what would come next.

We know what it costs to send young Americans to wars of choice. More than 4,000 of my fellow servicemembers came home in flag-draped coffins. Tens of thousands more came back with wounds, visible and invisible, that we’re still learning how to treat. And so many of the people sent to fight there were barely out of high school.

A few weeks before the war, my younger brother wrote me a letter. He saw through the case being made in Washington that sent his brother to combat. Our elected officials should have seen through it as well.

And that’s what concerns me now. We’re seeing the same playbook again — shifting claims, no clear definition of the mission, and no real explanation of what success looks like. Once again, young Americans are being put in harm’s way while the people making these decisions will never be the ones to pay the price.

If you believe we need leaders who understand the real cost and are willing to challenge it before it’s too late, will you join me in building this campaign?

clean_body: The warning signs are already here. | | Hey team, I published an op-ed in the on Friday about something I’ve carried with me since my time serving in Iraq. = 23 years ago, George Bush sent me and my fellow Marines to Iraq based on lies. I remember how quickly things moved, how the case was made, how the decision was taken, and how little clarity there was about what would come next. We know what it costs to send young Americans to wars of choice. More than 4,000 of my fellow servicemembers came home in flag-draped coffins. Tens of thousands more came back with wounds, visible and invisible, that we’re still learning how to treat. And so many of the people sent to fight there were barely out of high school. A few weeks before the war, my younger brother wrote me a letter. He saw through the case being made in Washington that sent his brother to combat. Our elected officials should have seen through it as well. And that’s what concerns me now. We’re seeing the same playbook again — shifting claims, no clear definition of the mission, and no real explanation of what success looks like. Once again, young Americans are being put in harm’s way while the people making these decisions will never be the ones to pay the price. name: Nina Ahmad
subject: Please Check Out My Op-Ed in Defense of Lankenau Environmental Science Magnet High School
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nina for Philly
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nina2025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nina2025]
Hi Friend,
I wanted to share with you that yesterday I released an Op-Ed in the Philadelphia Tribune in defense of Lankenau Environmental Science Magnet High School . [https://www.phillytrib.com/commentary/closing-lankenau-undermines-environmental-justice-education/article_12f20c01-a18b-4d17-acdc-22a30c654527.html] I hope that you will engage with this piece and share this important and timely information with your friends and loved ones.
Over the past few months, I have attended multiple events with the Lankenau community, issued two letters to the School District, and been busy advocating and organizing. At a time when environmental protections are being rolled back across the country, Philadelphia should be doing everything in its power to prepare the next generation of environmental leaders, scientists, planners, and public servants . Instead, the School District is considering closing Lankenau Environmental Science Magnet High School, one of the most distinctive public schools in our city and a rare pathway into environmental careers for students who have too often been left out of them. I argue that this is a profound mistake.
I refuses to stand by while an outstanding school like Lankenau is threatened with closure . I call upon the school district to reconsider its recommendation to close the school; and provide clear, objective justification for why a school with this mission, this record, and clear value should be closed.
"Closing Lankenau would send exactly the wrong message. It would tell students from low income and underrepresented communities that even when a school is innovative, mission driven, academically successful, and uniquely aligned with the future economy, it can still be treated as expendable."
- Councilmember Dr. Nina Ahmad
I hope that you will join me and read the entire op-ed at the Philadelphia Tribune [https://www.phillytrib.com/commentary/closing-lankenau-undermines-environmental-justice-education/article_12f20c01-a18b-4d17-acdc-22a30c654527.html] .
Thank you and I'd love to hear any feedback!
Nina

| Peter,

**The first thing my friends and family will tell you is that I’ve never stopped “kicking ass for the working class.”**

So, why do I fight? Why do I take on the hard battles? Why do I stand up to bullies? Why do I speak out for the voiceless?

The answer is simple. _Silence has consequences._

Born in Orange, California, to working-class immigrants from Mexico, I was raised with the idea that families stick together. I built my life here and took advantage of the opportunities my parents never had. I serve because California deserves leaders who do not shrink when things get uncomfortable.

When Trump came for Social Security and Medicare, I fought back. When American jobs were shipped overseas, I stood up for U.S. workers and businesses. When small businesses were struggling, I championed a bill to help small businesses provide retirement benefits to their employees.

I do not fight for no reason. I fight because I care about my neighbors – families struggling to get by, young people uncertain about their future, and immigrants trying to build a life in this country.

**I don’t back down from bullies, and I don’t stay quiet when something is wrong.**

subject: Thanks to President Trump, our elections are less secure today than they were yesterday
body:

I don’t say this lightly: our elections are becoming more vulnerable.
Right now, the federal government is gutting key election security infrastructure that states have relied on for years.
The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency — created to protect our elections from cyberattacks and foreign interference — has lost staff, resources, and the trust of the very officials it was built to support.
As Oregon’s Secretary of State, I take the responsibility to protect our elections seriously. And I can tell you: when federal support weakens, states was local elections officials are forced to do more with less — at a moment when threats are only growing more sophisticated.
Here in Oregon, we’re jumping into action to protect our elections, but it’s an uphill battle.
If you believe secure, fair elections are worth fighting for, I’m asking you to chip in $10 or whatever you can right now to help talk to Oregonians about what’s at stake → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
We’ve already seen attempted cyberattacks on election systems. We’ve seen how quickly disinformation spreads. And now, with fewer federal resources and less coordination, the risks are increasing.
Our democracy depends on trust — and trust depends on security.
I’m committed to doing everything I can here in Oregon to protect the integrity of our elections. But we need leaders at every level who are willing to stand up, invest in security, and take these threats seriously.
If you’re with me in that fight, please chip in today → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/read-em-24?]
Democracy works when we protect it.
— Tobias Read
Oregon Secretary of State

These pundits expected Democrats to just roll over while MAGA redrew the maps in state after state, locking in one-party rule for the next decade and beyond.
But thanks to the support of tens of thousands of Democrats nationwide who have rallied to our cause, we've proven that when Democrats fight, they win.
And now national Democratic leaders are joining the fight. CNN reports that Democratic House Minority leader Hakeem Jeffries is backing our effort to counter MAGA election rigging in Colorado:

Collecting 200,000 signatures means building a massive, statewide ground operation from scratch. We need to recruit, train, and deploy thousands of signature gatherers in every corner of Colorado, from Denver to the Western Slope to the Eastern Plains.
Our team estimates it will take at least $3,000,000 to fund an operation of this scale. Having only launched our efforts a few months ago, we are still well short of that goal.
With national leaders like Hakeem Jeffries stepping up to back our effort, we now have the political muscle behind us. Now we just need the resources to build the massive statewide operation required to put this initiative on the ballot.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Republican members clutch their pearls at spending on health care, but cheer on spending it on an unnecessary war
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I ran for office because of my experience as a caregiver to my husband Andy when he battled terminal cancer.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=2996%2E21716%2EOh-qQy)
Today marks the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act.
For millions of families, the ACA meant something simple, but life-changing: the peace of mind that if you got sick, you wouldn’t lose everything.
**And right now, that promise is on the line.**
Republicans made the largest cuts to health care in American history and let critical ACA tax credits expire, sending costs skyrocketing for working families — **forcing families to drop coverage** — all to fund tax breaks for billionaires. At the same time, they’re spending nearly a billion dollars a day on Trump’s war of choice.
**Republican members clutch their pearls at spending on health care, but cheer on spending it on an unnecessary war.**
[**If you’re ready to hold them accountable, pitch in any amount you can to help me fight back, protect our healthcare, and win back the House this November?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260323-1.P4ie6z&refcode=em20260323-2996&t=2&akid=2996%2E21716%2EOh-qQy)
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260323-1.P4ie6z&amount=5&refcode=em20260323-2996&t=3&akid=2996%2E21716%2EOh-qQy)**
This fight is personal for me.
I ran for office because of my experience as a caregiver to my husband Andy when he battled terminal cancer. And while Andy ultimately lost his life to cancer, up until his last breath, we both knew how lucky we were to have health insurance.
But no one’s access to health care should depend on luck.
And no family should have to face the worst moments of their lives, wondering if they can afford it.
**That’s why, as long as there is air in my lungs, I won’t stop fighting — to protect the ACA, lower costs, and finally guarantee health care for everyone.**
But I can’t take on these fights alone.
[**So, I’m asking again: On the anniversary of the ACA, will you chip in any amount to help me keep up the fight for health care?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1184?c0=mcb-em-20260323-1.P4ie6z&refcode=em20260323-2996&t=4&akid=2996%2E21716%2EOh-qQy)

Thank you,
— Sarah

## Toddler Defies Odds at Mom's Wedding

## Hit Song's Number Now a Cancer Lifeline
The phone number made famous by Tommy Tutone's 1981 hit [_867-5309/Jenny_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu4yAUAL_G7oh4-VVQbJMu226JjuEQs3sAC-Nk_fdXub9w65FmpPnzsA-IFPPzNyQ04RlsC8VmfB-ErWG1KVZwhG-gfzO_EOoOVwkBspVcjowrJpX1EOmyQ-9NQJSoejRimrRcJr6ofjNC-0ksYnSKazevzoug9TIs2q9zgKD7aD42rqSSXMyC38IM2ku_-oEP4FbVaY4-tlJvf0vMbcNAV3lhvbmSejJba_vRqV-dvHfyvmPZCT-ok_d0HtGxAKmcB8tnWrGyeZzYoPjCHGSHlW1IO8WMDP87Oo_4QibEIkcuVF-N39-RKB7j1Gn-TBDpu9p-vOtl5FcAAAD__0eyf4A) is being repurposed as a cancer support hotline. Tommy, 78, said his decision to get involved was driven by [personal experiences](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOrCAUgOGnwY7J8SCCBcVt7Oa2WxoGDsoOwgTJGN9-M_sKW__JV_xf9-VuY4p5_W93MmENSwtlyXQeiVqjuuyxWpfotOmp4SJbX_YqIdi8IODIQXAUi7cxXYvsvAlESKIj0ys14KRgEt1mwPdB0-iksDo40hYGCZMCqZ3U3k9dNB8NBAqEXvdwC9oOHv3DS5DWPQQbgHxspd6-S8xto5Cu8qZ6c2Xvktlaex1M_GM4M5zbRltM6dMYzo9U1oPhHDNvG_FnLifDWSqt9DRyPSouBUzc2eyo8q20FDMxnLtq_OuMKcVjVGyAdbfx1-zan0e9Df4EAAD__4dpe9g) with cancer in his family, along with his own health concerns. The free helpline connects callers with trained specialists who help navigate treatment and resources. Organizers say the goal is to make support more accessible by tying it to a familiar number, giving people an easy and even slightly uplifting way to reach out.

Turns out some family traditions are worth waiting a lifetime for. Join us for this week's Feel Good Flyover Podcast , where host Amy Hess shares exclusive stories, including an uplifting story of two Rhode Island gas station workers who braved a 36-hour shift during a blizzard to support plow drivers and essential crews. Plus, two more podcast-exclusive feel-good stories you won't want to miss. Check out this list of 19 things to cut when money gets tight from today's sponsor, . | Toddler Defies Odds at Mom's Wedding A Manchester, England, mother got an unexpected moment of joy when her 3-year-old son, once told he might never walk, helped at her November wedding. Kimberly Waterworth said she was "overwhelmed" as her son Chester took those steps, just a year after with severe global developmental delay affecting his ability to eat, grow and move. Doctors had warned the boy might never walk after early struggles with feeding, weight gain, and airway issues. Progress came with medical care and support from a local nursery, where staff helped him build strength and confidence. Kimberly credited those caregivers with helping make the milestone possible. Message in Bottle Sparks 25-Year Bond A message in a bottle tossed from a cruise ship near Norway in 1997 after washing ashore in Tasmania in 2001. Diane Charles found the barnacle-covered bottle, , Colombian traveler Erika Boyero, and the two began corresponding across continents. The pair stayed in touch for more than two decades, sharing life updates and milestones despite never meeting face to face. Erika said she had long hoped to visit Tasmania and meet the woman who found her message. That finally happened this year, when Boyero traveled to Australia and reunited with Diane on the same beach where the bottle was discovered. . Hit Song's Number Now a Cancer Lifeline The phone number made famous by Tommy Tutone's 1981 hit is being repurposed as a cancer support hotline. Singer Tommy Heath partnered with the to turn the pop culture staple into a resource for people seeking guidance, information, and emotional support. Tommy, 78, said his decision to get involved was driven by with cancer in his family, along with his own health concerns. The free helpline connects callers with trained specialists who help navigate treatment and resources. Organizers say the goal is to make support more accessible by tying it to a familiar number, giving people an easy and even slightly uplifting way to reach out. | The following stories are featured exclusively on The Feel Good Flyover Podcast. Peter,

Today marks the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act, and it's hard to overstate how much it changed people's lives.

Before the ACA, insurance companies could _deny you coverage for a pre-existing condition. They could charge women more than men. They could drop your coverage when you got sick or put lifetime caps on care._ The ACA put a stop to all that.

It helped millions of people gain coverage, lowered costs for working people, and made preventive care more accessible. It expanded Medicaid, strengthened marketplaces, and made it possible for people actually to afford the care they need.

**_But here's the reality: This progress has never been guaranteed, and there is still more work to be done._**

The ACA changed the game when it came to affordable care, but there is still so much more to do. The fight isn't over until every American can access quality care when they need it.

**But MAGA Republicans are trying to take us backwards.** Republicans in Congress let ACA tax credits expire and are trying to strip protections for pre-existing conditions and let big insurance companies rip you off to pad their profits. _And our President would rather spend $200 billion on a war than fund quality care._

I'm working in Congress to protect the ACA, lower premiums, and keep expanding access to care so that no one has to choose between seeing a doctor and paying their bills.

Because health care should be there when you need it, period.

name: David Hogg
subject: Wake up
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
AIPAC-aligned super PACs flooded Illinois races with $22 million. This is our wake up call — we have to fight back harder.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260323-1&t=1&akid=3279%2E587540%2EKwXejb)
Peter,
**AIPAC-aligned super PACs flooded four Illinois primaries with a whopping $22 million to crush progressive candidates.**
When we wonder why asleep-at-the-wheel incumbents and establishment Democrats are out of line with the demands of the people they serve, this is why. Because $22 million buys representatives who answer to super PACs, _not people._
Let me be clear — what happened last week in Illinois is a warning of what’s about to come between now and November.
These super PACs showed up in Illinois to block progressive candidates and pick up seats. They’re not going to stop coming for progressive leaders, so we have to be ready to fight back twice as hard, with everything we’ve got.
Here’s what went down:
In IL-02, AIPAC’s front group “Affordable Chicago Now” dropped $4.5 million to take out **Robert Peters.** A proven fighter who has spent his career in the state senate fighting for working people. He’s raised the minimum wage, eliminated the grocery tax, and ended cash bail in Illinois. That seat now belongs to AIPAC, not the working class district Robert would’ve been a fearless fighter for.
In IL-08, the crypto industry and AI firms entered the race. “Elect Chicago Women,” “Chicago Progressive Partnership,” “Fairshake,” and the OpenAI-linked “Think Big” super PAC poured millions into this race to take out progressive fighter **Junaid Ahmed.** A fearless young leader who spent years organizing in his community, refused corporate PAC money, and ran on universal health care, a ceasefire in Gaza, and economic justice for the working class immigrant communities that make up IL-08.
Here’s the part that should really make your blood boil. These super PACs didn’t even put their real names on the ads — they hid behind grassroots, progressive sounding names like “Chicago Progressive Partnership” specifically designed to trick Democratic voters into thinking they were supporting candidates who would fight for their constituents.
**They lied. Because that’s what cowards with unlimited money do.**
We didn’t leave empty handed — progressive Democrats took home some great wins. **Daniel Biss** won IL-09 despite AIPAC going all in for Laura Fine. **La Shawn Ford** held on in IL-07 in the face of $2.5 million from a crypto super PAC. And Leaders We Deserve endorsed candidate **Demi Palecek** won in a five-way primary against hundreds of thousands of dollars in corporate money being spent against her.
Those wins matter. They prove that when we invest in progressive candidates early and stay organized, people power _can_ beat dark money.
We have what it takes to challenge power and take back our elections, but only if we fight like hell for it.
**[Special interests and super PACs are already planning their next move. Will you pitch in $5 today to make sure Leaders We Deserve can back bold, young progressives who have the spine to take on dark money and win?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260323_1_illinois.WlUEof&refcode=em20260323-3279&amount=5&t=2&akid=3279%2E587540%2EKwXejb)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260323_1_illinois.WlUEof&amount=5&refcode=em20260323-3279&t=21&akid=3279%2E587540%2EKwXejb)**
Illinois was the warning shot. We can’t afford to let them gain any more ground, Peter. Not from AIPAC, the crypto industry, or any other special interest group that thinks they can buy our democracy.
Let’s get to work.
Thank you,
David Hogg

name: Mallory McMorrow
subject: Taking stock
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McMorrow for Michigan
body:
I hope you’ll take the time to read this email.
| _Hey,_ _This is a longer email than what I usually send. I hope you’ll read it, but if you don’t have time,**[please consider making a donation to our campaign here.](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/4?c0=mam-em-mar2026.QSCXFi&refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260323_PM1_V1_S1&t=1&akid=4279%2E898137%2EOACypA) ** _Thanks!_
---
Friend,
I never set out to be in politics.
It's not what I went to school for, nor is it what I did for most of my career. When I first ran for office, I literally Googled "how to run for office." There was no political family dynasty, no trust fund, and no network of wealthy donors waiting to write me checks.
But I ran. And we won — swinging a deep red district _20 points_ against an incumbent Republican. Then I helped flip the Michigan state senate blue for the first time in nearly 40 years.
Since then, I've passed laws to reduce gun violence, raise the minimum wage to $15 an hour, and repeal Michigan's abortion ban. We've expanded civil rights, voting rights, and more.
We showed not only how to fight, but how to win, build power, and actually _deliver_ for Michiganders.
Now I'm running for U.S. Senate because we need leaders with backbone. We need leaders who will stand up to Trump _and_ have the vision to build something better after he's gone.
But here's what I really need you to understand:
**Michigan is the canary in the coal mine.**
This state doesn't just reflect national trends, it predicts them.
When the 2008 financial crisis hit, Michigan was ground zero. Between 2000 and 2010, we lost more jobs than any other state — 18.3% — years before the rest of the country felt the full weight of what was happening to the middle class.
When Rick Snyder gutted school funding and handed money to for-profit charters, Detroit became one of the most underfunded school systems in the country. Other states — Ohio, Indiana, Wisconsin — followed the same playbook.
And in April 2020, nine months before January 6th, armed militia groups stormed our state Capitol. Extremists plotted to kidnap our governor. Those weren't isolated incidents. They were a preview.
What happens in Michigan doesn't stay in Michigan.
Republicans know this. They'll spend whatever it takes to hold this Senate seat — propping up Trump's hand-picked candidate, Mike Rogers, with an avalanche of outside money. Yes, Trump won Michigan in 2024, and Rogers _almost_ pulled off a win against Elissa Slotkin. That means Rogers has near-universal name recognition from his last Senate run just a couple of years ago. They're counting on that.
But Michiganders are already living with the consequences of Trump's agenda. His tariffs are squeezing auto suppliers and workers. His budget bill puts over a dozen Michigan hospitals at risk of closing. Costs are going up while he hands tax breaks to billionaires. You can't run enough ads to make people forget what they're feeling in their own lives.
**This campaign has never been about me.**
I know you're exhausted. The headlines, the chaos, the lies — it's a lot. But exhaustion is exactly what they're counting on.
Here's the thing: you don't have to do everything. None of us do. But we each have to do _our one thing._
Pitch in. Talk to a neighbor. Share what's at stake. Trust that if enough of us each do our one thing, we can actually build something better together.
[ **If you've read this far, thank you. I hope you'll consider making your first contribution to this campaign. Every dollar helps us reach Michiganders who are ready for change in what is going to be one close race.** ](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/1898?refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260323_PM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4279%2E898137%2EOACypA)
| [DONATE $15](https://act.mcmorrowformichigan.com/go/1898?refcode=AU_MAM_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260323_PM1_V1_S1&t=5&akid=4279%2E898137%2EOACypA)
---
Mallory

Hi there!

I wanted to share a quick update with you, because our campaign for Lieutenant Governor keeps growing in ways that mean so much to me.

You saw earlier from my team that folks I’ve worked closely with here in Rhode Island are stepping up and endorsing this campaign.

Now, I’m so thrilled to see that support expand even further, **because Climate Action Rhode Island is backing our campaign along with national climate leader Bill McKibben.**

Support like this matters, not just because of the names, but because of what it represents. These are folks who have spent years doing the work — advocating, organizing, and pushing for real progress on protecting our future from climate change — and their support tells me that what we’re building is resonating.

At the same time, I keep coming back to the people who have been part of this campaign from the very beginning. The folks who live here, who care about this state, and who believe we can make government work better for people.

People like you, friend.

**[So I want to ask — will you add your name as a Community Endorser today?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fm0PEtH13lKa19ysjM2PTBUoiFCjN3VF7Aqxr4jgCU7CMIERsl1EGPZoeJla0GzHz1dvNEL8OYtO2ngph1D1K5_DBnbefe_LzgPI1dJumA2KllmUIqyh1qvBHq2wWOIwI320mHTpJJI0NJHip_QT_LEYekw86sNtRBjLBh9CjN_cPurx-1-MPB9zEq1crmL6MmxLXaTxe7PNmEjIQrXitWYOHKRbWy7HCSWnqb5agBnrPvK4QCW9VxOj5BWZjKW4Gep8gyhFy9slR44dxriipcG25KHp_n1eaR1hh-TTGSi37Xqd5hlBZkxsmX6GE7c1ft/4p6/J0wlJLB6Q4qfFqFU1lO9Jw/h0/h001.q7ZYo9H9UmSnlwVKe1wEl_kd_gMb3P6Gyo8lCFZ2_6A)** | | [ **ADD YOUR NAME** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uDKkapQVnT18L0ER7M9Fm0PEtH13lKa19ysjM2PTBUoiFCjN3VF7Aqxr4jgCU7CMIERsl1EGPZoeJla0GzHz1dvNEL8OYtO2ngph1D1K5_FpxtoX_4kU_uranNO1QGaj3UZuLPTkgNC7cJTiBoGox16iz2JJ5lPSMz1IkXiwzOdf62mbC4-Oq90NXVpujJD63MD_us8ZPN9X9O_JKsKoUDjn1IgmkoBDC8nDztO3_eYbfsEz5l20W1tMHHED9u-35tceONgUJUuWCAr2nXWuWwLERm_JzEtQuw8HyOU7gV2j56-bmdoajaYZHZVOKpBar2vggrjl7fz_3crzU-3sw/4p6/J0wlJLB6Q4qfFqFU1lO9Jw/h1/h001.1G-ATfwvJR_RukpwH7xI7RKcud0Lt2gVl7AJR3y5SqY)

I have looked up to and been inspired by him for years! Friend, This is not normal. Donald Trump suggested **“it should be my third term”** and declared that the **“only way”** Democrats can win is to cheat. Now, Trump is escalating efforts to bend elections to his will ahead of November – while simultaneously undermining public trust in the outcome.
* He’s called to “nationalize” elections, even though the Constitution leaves election administration to the states.
* His Justice Department is suing states for private voter roll data.
* The FBI has seized ballots from 2020 in Georgia.
* And Trump himself has said he will only accept the 2026 results “if the elections are honest.”

That’s not how democracy works. In America, voters decide elections. Not presidents. Not the Department of Justice. And not anyone who thinks they can rewrite the rules when the voters don’t agree with them. Democratic Secretaries of State are the frontline defense against federal overreach and election subversion, but they need the resources to be ready for anything. Dan Meuser is back from his Mar-a-Lago weekend getaway.
While he was schmoozing with insiders and partying with billionaires down in Florida, **we were at a town hall right here in Berks County talking about one of the ICE detention centers coming to wreak havoc on our communities. (Yes, we talked about more poop trucks.)**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2cf5ce46-d8a8-4f2d-850e-6ac13a258783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Meuser could've used this weekend to advocate for our local communities. Other Republican leaders have done it for their states. They told the White House that ICE facilities like the ones planned here would do real damage to their economies and their local communities, and it worked. They stopped them.
But Meuser didn't do that. He didn't stand up for us. He hasn't even shown up at a single one of the three ICE facility town halls held at local fire companies and borough buildings this year.
Listening and advocating for your constituents is the bare minimum of what a representative should do, and we're not even getting that.
**Because Meuser 's not in Congress for the people here. He's in it for himself.**
We're facing a choice between someone who runs off to a gold-plated beach resort when our district needs help and someone who actually steps up to solve our problems. It's Mar-a-Lago vs. local fire companies. Billionaires vs. communities. Meuser vs. us.

His family terrorized for years, children taunted with slurs in the streets, living under police protection for nearly a decade. This isn't a scene from some distant war zone. **This happened in Bradford, England – to Nissar Hussain.** **His only "crime"? Leaving Islam and embracing Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior.** For 17 years, Nissar endured relentless persecution from his former community. The Church of England? _**SILENT.**_ Not one bishop stood with him or his family. **But Save the Persecuted Christians, where I’m proud to serve as a board member, refused to stand by. We brought Nissar here to the U.S. to help him share his story, and he is now fighting back boldly – in part by pursuing a groundbreaking legal case against 11 countries that still mandate death for apostasy. ** [**Your support has amplified his voice and his mission to expose this evil.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b104c26bd56f4ae48bc8d58ad3502df8&_e=zcg3AeAOG0qa18tZkPrW1vUz-DpUMgUpSkDtoUnPkOS1EGBiJ1jfGKsEX1zBJpTIrNw3wxtunTuyeIp5exhM0Lz_5yDGbE2elnXNoir30otMJpbsjltic3nXgx6sSYSgqTg5XSg3ZE_1Dz_nC9FUf0s3WyoQ1N2zNKsmtHmI_b_cak0j_PbR0toncCSpMAzGbp4watKwyE6CN7UbIdR_fFsU8kVqG88Lg_0wWUP5P7FOl7FLaR8Uofkwyx5T-ARhrR0KKthrssylQadcJPjndNoP7WO_Yhe45CnDYtxr21z7dDj_nCSQMUcK4hURBgoCR-Rv37-febe7hJksmfK0XepAM4ZnKFaULEOav6e0pRVOspYzD4ko4iValCE0OnSXKef-MH-rGGET8E8QdF_tbWMKWT2xSsExcKGgjKkMTXrOLsM2nnbr1uN8ee6tWVIgiuYSmZcwOznQuJgcOsyyIW72J40sfoUIxljdmSgl7yjHTmw2JdA5mZbS6FJIDKGpD3xmMAZCxfZ8L1dQQZgR9LbXChqu0CRCl2U7X-IjgF_KTeeRjQWKVX9Xygp9BFlBaSzWM5uMXvtQNcnJOokmLxuyLM9bEXDxpJRVLchcyioSg3uoDC5gIDZITv3JRlxqkx99kONuEby5gt7neV7rUNISUjvqLTDtpjWdT1SvxNevt8xBu58qk1QOS0flWwiHk1IRLIXHMyQZ_KhvycEVuLOdmh_AvGBZdtmNROflcUM%3D) Nissar's story is heartbreaking, but it's not isolated. | | Republicans kept the Senate in Washington this weekend to try to force through a bill called the "SAVE Act." They claim it is designed to stop NON-CITIZENS from voting. But that is BS. The goal is to stop CITIZENS from voting. The bill requires every state to hand over its voting registration list to Trump. Then, Trump and his team are allowed to purge the list of people they think might not be qualified to vote. For example, 69 million women whose married name is different from their birth certificate would be purged off the list. So would 4 million men who have changed their last name. And Trump could purge them just before the November election, giving them little time to follow the very strict rules for re-registering. You can't even re-register using your birth certificate alone. You need to have an additional "permitted" identification. You can re-register with a passport, but it takes $165 and six months to acquire one if you don't have one already. Not only could you not get the passport in time, but the cost makes it a poll tax. And that's not all. Student IDs and Tribal IDs could not be used to vote, even after you've gone through the rigorous re-registration process...even if your ID is backed up by your matching signature! The bill is designed to create hurdles for four groups to vote: women, students, Tribal members, and the less affluent. Citizens who have moved often — and don't have files handy with a birth certificate — are in a real bind. And the bill effectively bans vote-by-mail. This submits citizens to all kinds of election corruption if they vote on Election Day: changing the location of precinct voting officers; giving out misinformation about the date and the location for voting; putting in staff or machines that work slowly and create long wait times; and putting polling places where there is little parking, which could make it hard for seniors or folks who have mobility issues. In short, the SAVE Act is all about rigging the November election and enabling Trump to entrench an authoritarian government that tosses aside all the checks and balances and divisions of power of our Constitution. clean_body: There’s nothing about it that protects our democracy. | | | | Republicans kept the Senate in Washington this weekend to try to force through a bill called the "SAVE Act." They claim it is designed to stop NON-CITIZENS from voting. But that is BS. The goal is to stop CITIZENS from voting. The bill requires every state to hand over its voting registration list to Trump. Then, Trump and his team are allowed to purge the list of people they think might not be qualified to vote. For example, 69 million women whose married name is different from their birth certificate would be purged off the list. So would 4 million men who have changed their last name. And Trump could purge them just before the November election, giving them little time to follow the very strict rules for re-registering. You can't even re-register using your birth certificate alone. You need to have an additional "permitted" identification. You can re-register with a passport, but it takes $165 and six months to acquire one if you don't have one already. Not only could you not get the passport in time, but the cost makes it a poll tax. And that's not all. Student IDs and Tribal IDs could not be used to vote, even after you've gone through the rigorous re-registration process...even if your ID is backed up by your matching signature! The bill is designed to create hurdles for four groups to vote: women, students, Tribal members, and the less affluent. Citizens who have moved often — and don't have files handy with a birth certificate — are in a real bind. And the bill effectively bans vote-by-mail. This submits citizens to all kinds of election corruption if they vote on Election Day: changing the location of precinct voting officers; giving out misinformation about the date and the location for voting; putting in staff or machines that work slowly and create long wait times; and putting polling places where there is little parking, which could make it hard for seniors or folks who have mobility issues. In short, the SAVE Act is all about rigging the November election and enabling Trump to entrench an authoritarian government that tosses aside all the checks and balances and divisions of power of our Constitution. We must stop this authoritarian bill. I'm a HELL NO on the SAVE Act. The right to vote is fundamental, and I will not stand by while politicians try to rig the rules to hold onto power. Let's save our republic! body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | |
Peter,

The war on Iran cost the United States more than _$16 billion_ in its first week alone. **Now, Pete Hegseth, the Secretary of War (Crimes), is requesting an additional $200 billion to fund this war, a price tag he has already signaled could go even higher.**

And still, the Trump Administration has failed to answer the most basic questions:

_Why was this war launched without public explanation or congressional authorization? What U.S. interests are actually being served? What does success even look like?_

**Americans are being asked to foot a $200 billion bill without a plan, without transparency, and without accountability.**

Meanwhile, gas prices are climbing, groceries and everyday essentials are becoming harder to afford, and America’s standing with our allies and trading partners is disappearing faster than our snowpack - damage that could take decades to repair.

Eastern Washington understands the true cost of war. Our communities include veterans, active-duty families, and neighbors who have borne the burden of past conflicts.

So you would expect our representative to stand up for our interests. Instead, Michael Baumgartner is serving as a rubber stamp for the extreme MAGA agenda - happily handing Congress’s power of the purse to the executive, cheering on new endless wars, and further alienating our allies and neighbors.

**We need adults in the room making decisions about war and peace. We need leaders willing to ask hard questions, defend congressional oversight, and put problem-solving ahead of politics.**

That’s why we must secure a historic victory in November and send Carmela Conroy to Congress.

[**It’s also why we need to hear from you today - hit reply on this email and tell us how this conflict is affecting you - whether it’s rising costs, uncertainty, or concern for loved ones in uniform.**](mailto:info@conroy4congress.com?subject=Response%20to%203%2F20%20Survey&body=) **Carmela and our team will read every response because your voice should shape the decisions made in your name.**

With over two decades of experience as a U.S. Foreign Service Officer, including in active conflict zones, Carmela will bring to Congress a commitment to public safety, community stability, and steady leadership abroad that this moment demands.

And with your continued support, victory - and responsible leadership - is within reach.

\- Team Conroy

# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=2138%2E791427%2EPnMDnY)
Friend, after our successful push to get Kristi Noem fired as DHS Secretary, the Trump administration scrambled to find a replacement.
Now, they’ve picked Senator and MAGA fanatic Markwayne Mullin to be the next head of this violent, mismanaged, scandal-plagued department. He’s already cleared committee hearings, and is on his way to being confirmed by the Senate.
Pushing out Kristi Noem was a major victory and a huge hit to this administration’s credibility. But no matter who takes her job, they will serve Trump and Trump alone. They will ruthlessly carry out his mass deportation agenda.
That’s why it’s up to us to finish the job and address the root of this crisis: **ICE must be abolished.**
ICE has become the centerpiece of Trump’s cruel regime, acting as a secret police force that operates outside the law. They have stepped on our civil rights, brutalized Americans, and committed a host of human rights violations. They still haven’t even conducted an **_investigation_** into the murders of Alex Pretti and Renee Good, let alone sought criminal accountability.
If we are going to end Trump’s reign of terror and chart a new path forward on immigration — one where the system works safely, effectively, and compassionately — ICE simply cannot be allowed to remain as a bulwark of brutality and lawlessness.

name: LeftNet
subject: [SURVEY] Has the rise in health care costs affected you and your family?
body:
Today marks the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act.
#
**Today marks the 16th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act.** For many families, it has been the difference between being able to see a doctor and going without care.
But right now, health care is getting even harder to afford. Congressional Republicans allowed the ACA subsidies that helped keep premiums affordable to expire at the end of last year, and now millions of people are paying the price.
→ About **9%** of people who were enrolled in ACA plans last year have already dropped coverage
→ Another**17%** are at risk of doing the same because they can’t afford their new premiums.
→**More than half** of the people who reenrolled said they have cut or plan to cut spending on basics like food and clothing just to pay for health care.
In a country as wealthy as the United States, people should not have to choose between health care and groceries, rent, or keeping the lights on. _**We deserve better.**_
If you agree and you’re willing to share, we want to hear from you. **[Will you take our quick two-question survey and tell us how rising health care costs are affecting you and your family?](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/aca-anniversary/?source=em20260323-1531&t=1&akid=1531%2E2118727%2EFmYSEJ)**
**[TAKE THE SURVEY ››](https://act.leftnet.org/survey/aca-anniversary/?source=em20260323-1531&t=2&akid=1531%2E2118727%2EFmYSEJ)**
Thanks for sharing.
— LeftNet

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127915653/609632241/-441730885?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTg2MDdhOS1mZDI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9r7YLH0DNPmJ54-tlVL4V8ytav2fXEZO3ZjwnKIL1MI=)
I didn't get elected to get rich, Peter, and neither should anyone else. We're public servants. It's so basic that Members of Congress shouldn't use our positions for personal gain that I was genuinely surprised by what I've seen from some of my colleagues. And collectively, the specter of insider trading weakens the public trust in Congress. **That's why I've helped lead a bill -- the No Getting Rich in Congress Act -- that will make long-overdue changes to what members can do.** This effort will:
* Ban buying or selling stocks, commodities, and even crypto by public officials and families
* End enrichment on behalf of adversaries, to keep government decisions free of outside influence and keep electeds from getting paid off by foreign bad actors
* End shadow lobbying and spouse loopholes, blocking spouses from using their partner's position for self-enrichment (_sorry Shawn!!!_)
* Tighten reporting and enforcement around each of these new rules, and more

This isn't my first time pushing for greater transparency and accountability from our public servants, and I hope my colleagues join me here so we can make it the last. [**If you agree and are ready to see change, add your name today to support this effort and demand that our electeds end stock trading in Congress.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127915654/609632242/-378511111?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTg2MDdhOS1mZDI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9r7YLH0DNPmJ54-tlVL4V8ytav2fXEZO3ZjwnKIL1MI=&emci=1e16eee7-fc26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=ae8607a9-fd26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=18052858) | [Add Your Name](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127915655/609632243/-378511111?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhZTg2MDdhOS1mZDI2LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9r7YLH0DNPmJ54-tlVL4V8ytav2fXEZO3ZjwnKIL1MI=&emci=1e16eee7-fc26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=ae8607a9-fd26-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=18052858)

body:
Lindsey Graham wasn’t there. Lindsey Graham didn’t do anything. The Marines did.
#
Peter, hey — it’s Travis. Former Marine, current Political Director here at VoteVets.
Yesterday, armchair quarterback extraordinaire Lindsey Graham was on FOX News. He’s been the number one cheerleader for Trump’s wars of choice, and this Sunday was no different. He wants the Marine Corps to invade Kharg Island to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
That offensive would put U.S. Marines in ground combat on Iranian soil. There is no easy way for them to access or resupply on Kharg Island. They’d be under threat for days before they ever reached it. Once they got there it would be weeks, maybe months of grinding attritional warfare. A lot of them would die.
His response to that tactical assessment was: “We did Iwo Jima. We can do this.” First off, Lindsey Graham wasn’t there. Lindsey Graham didn’t do anything. The Marines did.
We fought World War Two because we were attacked. We were fighting to liberate the world from genocidal fascists. More than a million Americans were killed or wounded by war's end.
26,000 of those casualties were on Iwo Jima. More Marines were lost on Iwo Jima than in Iraq and Afghanistan combined. 27 Medals of Honor were earned for service on Iwo — more than any battle in American history — and more than half went to men who were killed-in-action.
Now, Graham wants thousands more Marines killed to fight a war of choice started by a 79 year old fortunate son who dodged the draft five times.
You join the Marines because you want to live up to those guys on Iwo Jima, Guadalcanal, Peleliu, Tarawa, Belleau Wood, and countless others. Marines are not afraid of combat. But what civilian leadership owes them is a war worth fighting, and that’s not what this is.
It’s tough watching this, knowing your fellow Marines could be put in harm’s way for another war they shouldn’t have to fight. But that’s why I’m so glad I found VoteVets. Standing up to Trump and these wars gives me purpose, and I know it’s the same for a lot of you.
So, if you want to help us fight back right now, I’m humbly asking you:

We can do this.” First off, Lindsey Graham wasn’t there. Lindsey Graham didn’t do anything. The Marines did. We fought World War Two because we were attacked. We were fighting to liberate the world from genocidal fascists. More than a million Americans were killed or wounded by war's end. 26,000 of those casualties were on Iwo Jima. More Marines were lost on Iwo Jima than in Iraq and Afghanistan combined. 27 Medals of Honor were earned for service on Iwo — more than any battle in American history — and more than half went to men who were killed-in-action. Now, Graham wants thousands more Marines killed to fight a war of choice started by a 79 year old fortunate son who dodged the draft five times. You join the Marines because you want to live up to those guys on Iwo Jima, Guadalcanal, Peleliu, Tarawa, Belleau Wood, and countless others. Marines are not afraid of combat. But what civilian leadership owes them is a war worth fighting, and that’s not what this is. It’s tough watching this, knowing your fellow Marines could be put in harm’s way for another war they shouldn’t have to fight. But that’s why I’m so glad I found VoteVets. Standing up to Trump and these wars gives me purpose, and I know it’s the same for a lot of you. So, if you want to help us fight back right now, I’m humbly asking you: If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly:_ | | ** | | | | | | | ** Semper Fi, Travis Tazelaar Marine Corps Veteran Political Director, VoteVets PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS.ORG, NOT AUTHORIZED BY ANY CANDIDATE OR CANDIDATE’S COMMITTEE Use of military rank, job titles or photographs in uniform does not imply the endorsement of the Department of Defense, Departments of the Army, Navy, Air Force, or the Marines or Space Force.

body:
TN-5 deserves better.

| | | | |
---
Peter,

Over the last week or so, my opponent has made headlines again for an angry rant online. But moments like this aren’t really new. Many of you may remember when he clashed with protesters last year — people who were, at the end of the day, his own constituents. At some point, it stops being a one-off moment and starts to look like a pattern. Here’s what I believe: leadership should show strength, but strength without cruelty. The job of a representative isn’t to escalate every disagreement or turn every moment into a spectacle. It’s to listen to people, even when they’re frustrated. It’s to lower the temperature, not raise it. [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/oSpJ9hI7P6Ga0Em3ZphCZg~~/AAUS1hA~/KSLhdcmpMJa63p1TUklnGwCZbzQHtJLWvFSYCfFS3iGvQ0fLOqrEpjpV8YrGuxnUaSrYxojRDQVC8Ae9CtnwqqMZR-FUH0eQoUXRrEtxw7EIfqNM8-4heOBacVCzVRXPdA8F08jGKYGebOJmJBFeBcR34IcJyzmybx4MG3WmTN16-RCuUktuWhRgf9v24Yb4KifuDzOPNzAkcz0OKSmbC_p8az6cg0iNKPmql9Le6JogLh_XJLOiqej--SKRe6WVzJhPGeq-MMk11ijJrN_x1A~~) As mayor of Columbia, I’ve had plenty of tough conversations with people who disagree with me. That comes with the job. But leadership means meeting those moments with a level head and respect, not outrage. **Because the truth is, the loudest voice in the room isn’t always the strongest one.** TN-5 deserves leadership that’s focused on fixing the problems that actually impact folks — not chasing viral moments. If you believe our politics can be better than what we’re seeing right now, I hope you’ll stand with this campaign.
